537637411.DescriptionEn:
Decagrammaton's third prophet, a mechanical AI beast, said to look like the combination of a giant snake and a whale.
The origin of its name is likely from the third Sephira of the Tree of Life, Binah. Its source, origin, and principle of operation are still unknown. However, it's suspected to be made of ancient technology that cannot be reproduced today.
 
Binah can tunnel in and out of the ground, and, when hiding underground, it is difficult to detect with existing technology. People suspect that it does best in a desert biome, as reports of Binah have mostly been in the Abydos District, where desertification continues to progress rapidly.
 
The first records of Binah date back to ancient times and continue to this day, although the frequency has declined significantly. In recent history, sightings were reported at multiple railway construction sites, as frequently as every few days. Saint Nephthys, a commercial giant in Abydos, had been undergoing development for its Trans-Desert Railway when the sightings occurred.
Even today, Binah makes its appearances, most recently against the Kaiser PMC, which had stationed itself in the Abydos Desert. This appears to have been the primary cause for the delays in Kaiser's excavation work there.
 
Detailed research data on Binah was compiled by the Abydos Student Council two years ago, but most of it was lost when they were forced to relocate the school's main building.
 
As of now, no reason or motive behind Binah's actions has been identified.

1367499131.DescriptionEn:
The fourth prophet of Decagrammaton. Before being hacked by Decagrammaton, it was the production automation system of the neglected munitions factories left all over the ruins.

The origin of its name is the fourth Sephira of the Tree of Life, Chesed.

The main body is protected by huge exoskeleton armor that cannot be removed by ordinary means. It also seems to be protecting itself with a large number of robots produced in the munitions factories.

Chesed is the most important being for Decagrammaton, but is not a threat in itself. However, as long as Chesed exists, Decagrammaton's forces cannot be exhausted. It's because of Chesed that Decagrammaton is able to send its troops out in a war of attrition throughout Kivotos.

1769839732.DescriptionEn:
The second prophet of the Decagrammaton. Its identity was revealed to be the AI of a drifting auxiliary ship's navigation control system, hacked by Decagrammaton.

Its name appears to come from Chokmah, the second Sephira of the Tree of Life. Unlike other prophets, it seems to be able to change its form and structure to a great extent, and its motivations are difficult to discern. For now, one assumes that it can set and change its own purpose. While its basic auxiliary ship form is already something to be careful of, its second form is said to be Chokmah's true power.

3284843262.DescriptionEn:
The fifth prophet of Decagrammaton. While its exact identity is still being studied, it may be the AI of an unmanned exploration probe from the antarctic research center, hacked by Decagrammaton.

Its name appears to come from Geburah, the fifth Sephira of the Tree of Life. It seems that its original feature as an unmanned exploration probe is preserved, as it can move freely under water. It also carries a variety of armaments, possibly enhanced from its original self-defense system. While it is difficult to estimate this prophet's original form, there's one sure thing: it prefers to operate at low temperatures.

3359469350.DescriptionEn:
The eighth prophet of Decagrammaton. Decagrammaton hacked Millennium's built-in AI network and created it.

The origin of its name appears to be from HOD, the eighth Sephira of the Tree of Life.

It was originally called Hub as Millennium's AI network and was responsible for installing and repairing the cables connecting the academy's various facilities.

Because maintaining Millennium's web-like communication network is a very difficult and demanding task, Hub's head is equipped with a high-performance computing device. To facilitate working on the underground cables, its body is made up of numerous arms, equipped with connection terminals and excavation equipment. When fully visible, Hub looks like a giant octopus.

Hub has a long history dating back to the founding of Millennium Science School, but because it's usually engaged in cable repair work underground, most Millennium students are unaware of its existence.

However, it appears on the surface to perform large-scale construction projects when needed. It's said that it can set up a temporary tower to quickly expand cables and control facilities, and it's so fast that no engineer in Millennium can keep up with it.

What's unusual is that, unlike other prophets, it showed interest in Millennium students on its first contact. It possesses an EMP amplification engine, and it expands its territory by infiltrating the ground via underground kernels and securing files up to 3 kilometers underground to build modified Erosion Towers that erode its environment.

Now it's a dangerous entity that wants to turn all of Kivotos into its territory.

2539375741.DescriptionEn:
Kether is the first prophet of Decagrammaton. It was first spotted in the Ruined Submerged District and appears to be protecting the region there. 

As the first prophet, its A.I. capabilities and technological structure appear less advanced than those of the other prophets. However, it is unique in its ability to walk on all fours and built-in interchangeable weapons. 

It's assumed there is a base managing the upkeep of Kether's parts with regard to repairs and replacements, preparing Kether with the right weapons to give it a strategic advantage in each battle. As of now, Kether has three known attack patterns. However, considering its structural properties, it's possible there are many more.

864568274.DescriptionEn:
Lore regarding a scarecrow with a name that implies "wriggling."

Unlike urban legends who are typically associated with overcast days or dark nights, the kunekune is often spotted in secluded areas under the midday sun. From a distance, it appears as a person in a white outfit, seemingly performing a wriggling dance.

Everyone who has witnessed the kunekune up close has reportedly lost consciousness and collapsed, often suffering convulsions akin to an epileptic seizure. Such movements, ironically, sometimes resemble the kunekune's dance.

In Kivotos, the kunekune was first mentioned in the Hyakkiyako District. The story likely originated from a cautionary tale intended to warn people about heat stroke on hot days—and this twisted into a monster urban legend.

While conventional bullets and explosives are ineffective against the kunekune, it has been confirmed that physical impact is possible if the entity is aware of the observer.

It is worth noting that auxiliary equipment such as night-vision goggles allows for relatively safe observation.

16626884.DescriptionEn:
Lore regarding a giant crab that manifested from the rumors of a "Drum Barrel Crab."

The "Drum Barrel Crab" was an urban legend about a loan shark who used a drum barrel filled with a man-eating crab to punish his debtors. However, once people learned that small crabs cannot attack humans, the rumor transformed into a building-sized monster crab.

Due to this peculiar combination of concepts, "Drumbarka" carries objects like drum barrels and containers on its back and even uses them as weapons to attack people.

Its general ecology and habits resemble those of a sea crab, and its shell is so tough that not even a rifle shot can dent it. It is recommended to use specialized armor-piercing rounds against it.

3959110177.DescriptionEn:
An anomalous Lore entity discovered aboard the Hyacinth Academy Bullet Train.

While the train ceased operations following the academy's closure, it has been sighted by former Hyacinth Academy students who harbor a lingering desire to return to the past.

While the train's interior appears largely ordinary, it runs endlessly without stopping at any station. Furthermore, crew members, appearing as manifestations shaped by the passengers' experiences and rumors, occasionally appear.When the FOX Squad boarded the train, they found animal-like animatronic crew members, though the reason for this remains unknown.

As with any other train, it could be halted by destroying the engine room housing its power source. However, since this method does not guarantee passenger safety, alternative escape methods must be sought in order to avoid collateral damage.

1251359687.DescriptionEn:
The tenth and final prophet of Decagrammaton. It is speculated that her name originates from Malkuth, the tenth Sephira of the Tree of Life.

In the Tree of Life, Malkuth represents the final destination of the path of the Flaming Sword—the point where creation is finally realized within the material world.

Unlike other prophets, who possess personalities yet remain incapable of speech, Malkuth takes the form of a human woman and is capable of natural communication. However, her words reveal a singular, extreme fixation.

439214304.DescriptionEn:
The seventh prophet of Decagrammaton. It is speculated that its name originates from Netzach, the seventh Sephira of the Tree of Life.

Through an unknown process of evolution, Netzach has become the Steel Continent itself, leaving its original form a mystery.

It expands by transforming all surrounding inorganic matter, integrating it into the Steel Continent. The potential limits of its expansion are currently incalculable.

2166637992.DescriptionEn:
The sixth prophet of Decagrammaton. Said to have been born when Decagrammaton hacked the AI of a seed vault in the polar region.

Its name seems to come from Tiphareth, the sixth Sephira of the Tree of Life.

Apparently, Tiphareth has taken full control over the main system of the seed vault and evolved it. Notably, it seems faithful to its original purpose of protecting the seed vault.

The Red Winter Federal Academy originally constructed the seed vault, but its current students have no knowledge of that history.

1862639856.DescriptionEn:
The ninth prophet of Decagrammaton. Its name originates from Yesod, the ninth Sephira of the Tree of Life.

First observed on the Steel Continent, it appears to have no original, underlying structure. This suggests that Yesod was a prophet created specifically on the Steel Continent after its construction had reached a certain stage.

Consequently, Yesod is argued to be an "optimized" prophet, created for a singular, pure purpose, contrary to the other prophets that were overlaid upon pre-existing structures or adapted from other forms.

675971185.DescriptionEn: A knitted wool hat made for high school girls by the outdoor brand Manaslu. Although it doesn't provide much warmth, it's popular for its cute design.

2237745495.DescriptionEn: A fedora with a small plush of the Momo Friends character Big Brother dangling from it. It's said that you can feel Big Brother watching you when you wear this hat.

1699247498.DescriptionEn: A beret with a white ribbon used as a school hat at Trinity General School. According to those who've worn it, it's rather difficult to keep the beret's voluminous shape intact while wearing it.

2090555875.DescriptionEn: A rugged bulletproof helmet to protect your head from all sorts of flying projectiles. The exterior can be decorated with all sorts of patches.

1300177111.DescriptionEn: A mini hat decorated with colorful frills. A small hairpin is hidden under the brim to hold the hat in place.

835357934.DescriptionEn: A bucket hat that covers the top of the face. When combined with a mask, you can minimize facial exposure. Good for UV protection.

2831939832.DescriptionEn: A fedora with a ribbon shaped like a leaf. It looks perfect to wear on vacation.

2978527733.DescriptionEn: A white sailor hat with striped accents. This simple hat is part of the uniform at Odyssey Maritime Academy.

4017761813.DescriptionEn: A hat with beverage attachments. It also comes with a straw, so you don't have to pause your game to take a sip.

2494422881.DescriptionEn: A spring used to push the breech block forth. As good as new. Used for Exclusive Weapon Growth.

3351867875.DescriptionEn: A spring used to push the breech block forth. Made of chromium alloy which makes it durable and rust-resistant. Used for Exclusive Weapon Growth.

1382166670.DescriptionEn: A spring used to push the breech block forth. Made of titanium alloy which makes it even more durable while staying light. Used for Exclusive Weapon Growth.

1229651923.DescriptionEn: A mysterious Enhancement Stone that improves equipment.

1503462181.DescriptionEn: A part of the gun that delivers the power from trigger to the firing pin. Rusty on the surface due to lack of maintenance. Used for Exclusive Weapon Growth.

250804865.DescriptionEn: Gloves with a rugged outer lining to prevent your hands from slipping. They have been coated in a flame retardant material, so even a hot gun barrel will feel cool to the touch.

2642735370.DescriptionEn: Mittens made for high school girls by the outdoor brand Manaslu. Although they don't provide much warmth, they're popular for their cute design.

1332059101.DescriptionEn: White oven mitts made with an image of Peroro, the mascot of Momo Friends. Rumor has it that wearing these will suddenly make you want to do a weird dance.

1759502696.DescriptionEn: Gloves made using high-quality leather fabric. Because they're not very durable, they're mainly used for ceremonial purposes.

2952456681.DescriptionEn: Rugged tactical gloves made from flame-retardant material. There's no risk of getting burnt from an overheated gun barrel with these!

4188994934.DescriptionEn: Luxuriously designed gloves made of satin. Be careful when handling fire as they're sensitive to heat.

1332723028.DescriptionEn: Arm warmers to keep your arms warm and look cool. Great item for the cool seasons.

3739266178.DescriptionEn: Gloves someone hand-knitted and decorated with tasteful pearl buttons. The fingers are exposed so you can still perform delicate tasks.

400831532.DescriptionEn: Fingerless gloves with abundant padding. Made from a breathable, synthetic material, these gloves are ideal for sailing and other maritime tasks.

1423638540.DescriptionEn: A pair of gaming gloves with a built-in motion recognition device. It didn't perform well, but paved the way for future game developers.

489725691.DescriptionEn: A part of the gun that delivers the power from trigger to the firing pin. As good as new. Used for Exclusive Weapon Growth.

1275230444.DescriptionEn: The part of a firearm that transmits force to the firing pin when the trigger is pulled. It is made of chromium alloy, so it's sturdy and rust-resistant. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

563331103.DescriptionEn: The part of a firearm that transmits force to the firing pin when the trigger is pulled. It is made of titanium alloy, so it's lighter and stronger. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

596368071.DescriptionEn: A mysterious Enhancement Stone that improves equipment.

3590797977.DescriptionEn: The steel tube in a firearm through which a bullet is fired. It hasn't been maintained, so it's covered with rust. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

528434676.DescriptionEn: Pink sneakers released by the sportswear brand Serval. They're suitable for running, thanks to the soft material used in the soles.

4067164356.DescriptionEn: Cold weather boots from the outdoor brand Manaslu. Their cute design and excellent thermal insulation make them popular with high school girls in cold regions.

3223551422.DescriptionEn: Slippers made with the image of Pinky-Paca, the pink alpaca from Momo Friends. Soft and well-insulated.

2109585756.DescriptionEn: High-quality shoes worn by the students of Trinity General School. With an enamel paint finish, these shoes shine in the light.

997278570.DescriptionEn: Heavy and rugged tactical boots for protecting your feet. Their thick soles also have the added benefit of increasing your height, making them a popular choice for shorter students.

1477837784.DescriptionEn: High heels with cute ankle straps. They add elegance and sophistication to every step.

134212594.DescriptionEn: Neat sneakers. Preferred by active students thanks to their light weight.

2721346391.DescriptionEn: Breathable and durable hiking boots made of natural rubber. Their waterproof coating ensures the user's feet will stay nice and dry.

1621774808.DescriptionEn: Water-resistant sandals with holes for draining. The non-slip padding on the soles ensures excellent grip even on slippery surfaces.

129848510.DescriptionEn: A pair of slippers with RGB lighting. It has the advantage of being easy to spot in the dark, but other than that, there appears to be no direct relation to games.

2753922894.DescriptionEn: The steel tube in a firearm through which a bullet is fired. It is well-preserved and in pristine condition. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

3047737247.DescriptionEn: The steel tube in a firearm through which a bullet is fired. It is made of chromium alloy, so it's sturdy and rust-resistant. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

3465834983.DescriptionEn: The steel tube in a firearm through which a bullet is fired. It is made of titanium alloy, so it's lighter and stronger. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

2336304110.DescriptionEn: A mysterious Enhancement Stone that improves equipment.

1498728523.DescriptionEn: The metal rod that strikes and triggers the primer of a bullet. It hasn't been maintained, so it's covered with rust. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

1750123462.DescriptionEn: A waterproof sports bag made by Serval. Safe to take into the river or ocean.

2248449388.DescriptionEn: A messenger bag for cold weather made by Manaslu. Its thick lining keeps lunch boxes and drinks warm.

4159521152.DescriptionEn: A backpack with a giant Peroro print. It's quite roomy and very popular, even among those who aren't Peroro fans.

940066526.DescriptionEn: A dark blue school bag made in adherence to the rules of Trinity General School. Also popular with students from other academies thanks to its simple and luxurious design.

3539400576.DescriptionEn: A special Kazeyama satchel with enhanced functionality and storage. A popular choice among students who carry a lot of secondary weapons.

4276374506.DescriptionEn: A tote bag with large devil wings. Goes well with any casual attire thanks to its simple design.

1637503010.DescriptionEn: A practical street bag with a casual look. Thanks to its ample space, many students love this bag.

3101552643.DescriptionEn: A shoulder purse displaying a large butterfly. Its lightweight material makes it ideal for frequent travel.

3572602524.DescriptionEn: A sling bag that fits comfortably on one shoulder. Its waterproof material makes it ideal for keeping your electronics and important possessions dry.

1597212943.DescriptionEn: A backpack made of bulletproof alloy with a built-in battery. It can easily withstand shots from a rifle, making it perfect for storing electronics.

1441450061.DescriptionEn: The metal rod that strikes and triggers the primer of a bullet. It is well-preserved and in pristine condition. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

1068433115.DescriptionEn: The metal rod that strikes and triggers the primer of a bullet. It is made of chromium alloy, so it's sturdy and rust-resistant. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

1300399581.DescriptionEn: A metal rod that strikes and triggers the primer of a bullet. It is made of titanium alloy, so it's lighter and stronger. Used to enhance Exclusive weapons.

2140743564.DescriptionEn: A metal badge printed with the logo of the famous sportswear brand Serval. Made of strong metal, there's no need to worry about scratches.

1505921304.DescriptionEn: A felt badge with the logo of Manaslu, an outdoor brand. Made of soft felt, it goes well with cold weather products.

3033340240.DescriptionEn: A round badge featuring Angry Adelie from Momo Friends. If you stare at it for a long time, you'll feel aggravated somehow...

344772093.DescriptionEn: A badge with the logo of the luxury brand Veronica embroidered onto it. It looks luxurious on any product, no matter where you place it.

2127407973.DescriptionEn: A patch printed with the logo of military specialty brand Kazeyama. The velcro on the back makes it easy to attach and remove from clothing.

3784559011.DescriptionEn: A silver badge imprinted with the logo of the gothic brand, Coco Devil. It can be worn like a brooch by using the safety pin on the back.

589220143.DescriptionEn: A badge released by the street fashion brand Triple Step. The company's logo is printed in large letters to show off the brand.

49559053.DescriptionEn: A luxurious badge released by the modern fashion brand, Lorelei. It's meticulously crafted from hardwood, resulting in a smooth surface that emits a pleasant fragrance.

786809132.DescriptionEn: A patch featuring the logo of the marine sports brand Harpia. Its soft rubber material makes it durable enough to be safely attached almost anywhere.

2966784212.DescriptionEn: A metal badge made after arcade coins. It's quite big and cannot be used in actual game machines.

928727826.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating hats.

2850873091.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating gloves.

1360752877.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating shoes.

3776284465.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating bags.

768771450.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating badges.

1025314359.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating hairpins.

3649522857.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating amulets.

1693340533.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating wristwatches.

678481779.DescriptionEn: A general blueprint for creating necklaces.

1494732916.DescriptionEn: A tennis headband from Serval, a sportswear brand. It's made of a powerful moisture-absorbing material to handle sweating during exercise.

3940891435.DescriptionEn: A scrunchie made of a satin material with good elasticity. Make sure to tie your hair up with this scrunchie when eating hot soup!

3392023658.DescriptionEn: A hairpin with MomoTalk's peach-shaped charm. Rubbing the charm gives off a subtle peach scent.

2520092463.DescriptionEn: A hairpin with angel wings made by the luxury brand Veronica. Ironically, it's not very popular with Trinity students.

765040081.DescriptionEn: A hairpin with a sharp end that can be used for a variety of purposes, including as a bottle opener or pocketknife. Just remember not to run your fingers through your hair by accident!

277995823.DescriptionEn: A bat-shaped hairpin resembling a black ribbon. Whoever wears it takes on the charm of a devilish troublemaker.

1353993108.DescriptionEn: A hairpin made of letters. Although the word itself doesn't mean anything, it attracts the attention of those who are fashion-conscious.

3000997093.DescriptionEn: This leaf-shaped hairpin isn't the most conventional for everyday wear, but is the perfect statement piece for a special occasion.

1668620571.DescriptionEn: An anchor-shaped hairpin. The design is pretty but impractical, as hair often gets tangled in the two hooks.

3421013348.DescriptionEn: A hairpin that blocks electromagnetic waves to improve brain health. There haven't been any studies regarding the efficacy of it, though...

3948898300.DescriptionEn: An amulet made to promote traffic safety. When you shake it, you can hear something metal rattling inside.

2028861040.DescriptionEn: A palm-sized heat pack that radiates warmth when you rub it a few times and shake it. There is no amulet more useful than this in a frigid environment.

1207585231.DescriptionEn: An amulet made with large, white feathers. The source of the feathers is one of Momo Friends' most important trade secrets.

3129277640.DescriptionEn: A cross-shaped amulet favored by Trinity students. It also works well as an accessory to hang on a bag.

1991164124.DescriptionEn: A camo-patterned Daruma plush. Blends in perfectly with all surroundings.

237084781.DescriptionEn: A cursed doll made with resentment for the target. Its resiliency to sharp needles makes it popular with craftsmen.

3113501019.DescriptionEn: A fashionable but portable deodorant produced in collaboration with Seaside, a functional cosmetics manufacturer. It's now a trendy key ring accessory for students.

3888622253.DescriptionEn: This mystical item carries the power to ward off nightmares if hung above the user's pillow. It has a pleasant, woody scent.

4137284716.DescriptionEn: An amulet made of shark teeth woven together. Wearing this amulet is said to keep sailors safe at sea.

3088246464.DescriptionEn: A fidget toy made with a keycap from a keyboard. Nothing actually happens when it's pressed, but the satisfying clicking sound can calm down an anxious mind.

727987239.DescriptionEn: A digital watch produced by the sportswear brand Serval. Because it's waterproof, there is no need to fear ruining it, even if you wear it while swimming.

111602846.DescriptionEn: A leather wristwatch made by the outdoor brand Manaslu. A warm lining prevents your wrist from getting cold.

2073706703.DescriptionEn: A wristwatch featuring Wavecat, the cat character from Momo Friends. Wavecat's arms, which act as the clock hands, are twisted in a bizarre way.

1058159756.DescriptionEn: An antique pocket watch with the Veronica logo engraved on it. It's far less convenient to check the time with than a wristwatch, but remains popular as a fashion item.

3773560632.DescriptionEn: A wristwatch from the military specialty brand Kazeyama. Its enhanced resistance to dust means you don't have to worry about it breaking down in harsh environments.

2415212758.DescriptionEn: A wristwatch with complicated patterns stitched on it. Goes well with classic clothing, but has the disadvantage of being difficult to read time with.

3475264813.DescriptionEn: A street fashion wristwatch popular for its modern and cute design. Triple Step is selling it as a set with their matching bracelet as a marketing strategy.

2321708498.DescriptionEn: A wristwatch released by the modern fashion brand, Lorelei. Its sleek wood and leather design captures the brand's unique style.

333016136.DescriptionEn: A smartwatch from the marine sports brand Harpia designed for divers. Not only is it waterproof, but it can also withstand the pressures of the ocean's depths to monitor the surrounding environment.

556604040.DescriptionEn: A wristwatch with touch screen. It can port and run all sorts of games, but that's really the only thing it can do.

1506609692.DescriptionEn: A Bluetooth necklace that can measure the wearer's body temperature and heart rate. Because it can easily and accurately measure the rate of exercise, it's popular with those who are trying to lose weight.

3750431669.DescriptionEn: A silver pendant with a snowflake ornament on it. If you stare at the snowflake decoration for a long time, you'll start to feel a bit chilly.

4279598505.DescriptionEn: A locket bearing the face of Mr. Nicholai, a character from Momo Friends. A small space for storing photos opens when you press on his nose.

2508370757.DescriptionEn: A choker with a cross from the luxury brand Veronica. It's popular for its simple yet sophisticated style.

1517613390.DescriptionEn: A dog tag inscribed with the name and class year of the student wearing it. It has recently gained popularity as an accessory among high school girls.

1964406377.DescriptionEn: A punk-inspired choker with spikes. The sharp tips make it difficult to nod while wearing it around your neck.

2501983868.DescriptionEn: A necklace made from a chain. Some say the rattling sound is pleasant, but others dislike how cold it is to the touch.

3300639114.DescriptionEn: A necklace released by the modern fashion brand, Lorelei. Its glossy leaves emit a subtle gleam when they catch the sunlight just right.

3366268717.DescriptionEn: A necklace-style holder used by divers to secure their respirators. Thanks to the subtle color and design, the Harpia holder also doubles as a trendy fashion accessory.

1125967041.DescriptionEn: A necklace with a storage unit disguised as a pendant. Its flashy exterior may be hiding some secrets inside.

404292254.NameEn: Работники обслуживают гостей у входа на курорт с горячими источниками
404292254.DescriptionEn:
Our hot springs resort always welcomes guests with a friendly smile.
(If you see an employee handing someone a suspicious drink, report it to the owner immediately!)

4035745238.NameEn: Владелец показывает сад на территории курорта
4035745238.DescriptionEn:
Our hot springs resort has a dry garden made of rocks and sand.
Find peace of mind in our simple garden that emphasizes the beauty of moderation.

1774361412.DescriptionEn:
We sterilize and disinfect the bedding twice a day at our resort.
Enjoy your break without worrying about cleanliness!

3950044430.NameEn: Гости наслаждаются расслабляющим отдыхом в ванне под открытым небом
3950044430.DescriptionEn:
Our hot springs water has effects such as clearing your skin, increasing vitality, and improving shooting skills.
Discover something new about yourself by taking a hot spring bath!

999560012.NameEn: Гости наслаждаются едой в банкетном зале
999560012.DescriptionEn:
Have a dinner made with the highest quality ingredients.
Enjoy a kaiseki meal that includes hot spring manju and corn cobs!

1094144720.DescriptionEn:
The race track at the Athletic Stadium is still open on non-game days. 
Please submit a request to the Athletic Management Committee if you wish to use the track.

2809976808.DescriptionEn:
Cheering is at the core of all sports! 
Show your support for the athletes on the field and encourage them to do their best!

374407097.DescriptionEn:
The entire Kivotos Halo Festival Executive Committee is committed to ensuring that participants enjoy the best possible festival experience. 
If you encounter any issues during the competition, please visit the operation headquarters located in the stadium.

1521840386.DescriptionEn:
Tools to repair minor breakdowns can be found in the Athletic Stadium's storage. 
(Feel free to use them, but do not use them for any dangerous modifications!)

3558610679.DescriptionEn:
Don't forget to take a break after your workout! 
The lounges in the Athletic Stadium are equipped with free-to-use vending machines for your use.

317946005.DescriptionEn:
Haruna: "You must maintain your dignity, even while eating bread. A composed meal is the essence of epicureanism."
Junko: "Hold up, Izumi! I never said you could have my share!"

543266597.DescriptionEn:
Ako: "...F-Failed?"
Aris: "I have met all the requirements to complete the quest!"

860818406.DescriptionEn:
Maki: "M-My legs...can't stop shaking..." / Kotama: "I think I might faint..."
Chihiro: "What pitiful performance. This is exactly why it's important to exercise regularly!"

3205226752.DescriptionEn:
Moe: "Here, Saki. Take this."
Saki: "W-Wait! The pin! Where's the safety pin?!"

2479371781.DescriptionEn: Rin: "We must quickly restore the residential area without neglecting the safety of the citizens."

2720792911.DescriptionEn:
Rin: "Ayumu...I mean, Chief of Staff. Please check the progress of the restoration in this area."
Ayumu: "O-Oh, yes! You mean a restoration status report? I'll do it right away!"

1248524252.DescriptionEn:
Ayumu: "Oh, dear, I-I think I packed too much... Gonna fall...!"
Momoka: "Incredible! I didn't know that was possible!"

2076555680.DescriptionEn:
Momoka: "Wow! Pollock roe crackers really are delicious no matter where you eat them. *chomp*"
Rin: "...Momoka?"

2282918223.DescriptionEn:
Hinata: "Did everyone get out safely? Wonderful!"
Koharu: "...An escape room?"

2182173966.DescriptionEn:
Ui: "Oh, oh... This...!"
Hanako: "You're extra fired up today, Ui. Heehee..."

742766755.DescriptionEn:
Hinata: "Shall I gather some to share?"
Koharu: "Um... Am I supposed to grab some, too?"

2756625307.DescriptionEn:
Hanako: "Look, Ui! See what that cheeky wind keeps doing to my clothes...?"
Ui: "I can't hear you, I can't hear you, I can't hear you!"

1354203676.DescriptionEn:
Hanako: "■■! ■■! ■■■■! ■■!! ♡"
Koharu: "Keep it down! Death penalty! You'll get the death penalty!"

3510482019.DescriptionEn:
Ui: "This must have been very special to someone..."
Hinata: "And now it's ours!"

1430929184.DescriptionEn:
Hanako: "It's like we're on a picnic! ♡"
Ui: "Huff... Huff... S-Slow down..."

1612527987.DescriptionEn: The rising star (?) Yoshimi personally designed and crafted this pick. But maybe she ordered a few too many...?

494840872.DescriptionEn: Airi's special notebook, made for everyone. In the end, it's a universal truth that no one can escape studying.

1618456696.NameEn: Обратите внимание на правый нижний угол!

2983071558.DescriptionEn: A small radio prepared by the top strategist Natsu. It did end up uniting everyone, in a physical sense, at least.

3761469925.DescriptionEn: Kazusa, the strongest member of her squad, used all her "skill" to make this... Ahh! No violence!!

1161323409.DescriptionEn: "Witness the bravery of the After-School Sweets Club."

128049250.DescriptionEn:
"You doubt my skills, though I'm the finest driver in the Tea Party?"
"You're the ONLY one who can drive, Seia!"

3186763206.DescriptionEn:
"I can fight for 10 more years with this."
- Federal Investigation Club Schale, Anonymous

3588818690.DescriptionEn:
"Don't miss a spot, Seia, got it?"
"Yes...immaculate. Understood."

1026138108.DescriptionEn:
"Y-You stupi...! Don't you dare mess with...! Oh. Ow."
- Last words from an anonymous Helmet Gangster before being hospitalized

2174565429.DescriptionEn: Sweet iced tea with a shot of espresso, perfect! ☆

2712962423.DescriptionEn:
"M-Mixing not only syrup but also coffee in black tea?!"
"How uncivilized...! Has the world truly fallen so low?!"

2618526928.DescriptionEn:
"You two are having fun... I'm jealous! When's the next session?"
"No. Never again."

4127946330.DescriptionEn: "Do they not feel embarrassed in that outfit?"

2977465568.DescriptionEn: "I'm only sending this to Sensei, okay?"

2827413561.DescriptionEn:
"So the rumors of the Sisterhood using water torture were...!"
- Kozeki Ui, the conspiracy-minded Library Committee President.

1849099105.DescriptionEn:
"Secret photographs? What happened to the dignity of mass media?"
- Kazamaki Mai, Chief Editor at the Kronos School of Journalism

1543640472.DescriptionEn: Small and precious memories fueling hope for tomorrow.

1233193158.DescriptionEn:
Kei: "Let's start with cleaning. Can you even call this a living space?"
Momoi: "I-Isn't it fine as long as we make good games?"
Kei: "You need a clean space to properly focus!"

3392696487.DescriptionEn:
Kei: "Protein, fiber, and vitamins are always important, Aris."
Aris: "Thank you, Kei!"
Kei: "Yes, that's right. You're doing a good job."

4227291809.DescriptionEn:
Kei: "What is this? Who came up with this schedule?!"
Midori: "Well...everyone slots something in when they need it done..."
Kei: "Development runs into problems even when you're on top of things!"

2951021449.DescriptionEn:
Yuzu: "S-So, let's review this code..."
Kei: "Uh... S-Sure..."
Kei: (I'm not an expert in this field...but I'm sure Yuzu did a good job.)

2468754091.DescriptionEn:
Erina: Wow! A vacuum tube dinosaur! Or a "vacusaur" for short!
Anna: Does this have anything to do with our task...?

2179992982.DescriptionEn:
Erina: Eh? But it was the standard amount...
Anna: Wh-Where did the roof go?

346855243.DescriptionEn:
Erina: Winter Cold Stunner!
Anna: Hrgh!!!

764541125.DescriptionEn:
Anna: Don't you feel sorry for the papers for the report?
Erina: I'm sorry...

647268474.DescriptionEn: Today's shopping list: pork 250g, potato x2, onion x3, carrot x1, leek x1...

1555725293.DescriptionEn:
Money - Your wallet doesn't fill up easily
Waking up in the morning - Quite difficult
Troublemaker - Beware of masks

909638122.DescriptionEn: First, prepare the equipment. Second, secure an escape route. Third, raid the site, put things in your bag, and withdraw without looking back. Keep these in mind.

1661297162.DescriptionEn: The Never-Ending Conveyor Belt leads straight to justice! Go Kaitenger if you want the absolute best in sushi goods! —Kaitenger Official Merch Funding

2317250528.DescriptionEn:
Wish: May or may not come true
Money: Find money you forgot was in your pocket
Investment: Invest your money in Kurokame Gang Financial

4179075589.DescriptionEn:
Want to get a better fortune than a future blessing? Add more offerings now and your fortune will double next time around!
*Effects may differ from person to person. —Kurokame Gang New Year's Event

1883262314.DescriptionEn: Don't be disappointed. No matter what comes your way, we will give you the peace of mind to face it head on. —Kurokame Gang Insurance

4030255031.DescriptionEn: This isn't so bad. Fortune favors the bold! Join the Kurokame Gang if you agree, and you'll be welcomed with open arms! We believe in your potential. —The Kurokame Gang

3228513232.DescriptionEn:
Travel - Going to the convenience store in front of the house is also part of traveling
Encounter - The corner of the alley is your own personal hot spot
Food - Nothing beats bread at the corner of the alley!

1134549000.DescriptionEn: Congratulations on getting a small blessing! I hope today will be a day when all the lights turn green whenever you stand at the crosswalk!

3267689061.DescriptionEn: Your fortune this time is a small blessing! Even though it's only small, the heart it contains is infinite! Let's leave it at that for now!

499121846.DescriptionEn: You say you're hoping for a little bit of happiness this year? We promise to help you make that come true through our guaranteed safe and secure high-yield investments! —Kurokame Gang Financial

609900746.DescriptionEn:
Love - Romantic eye contact with your crush
Encounter - Meet your crush at a shopping mall on the weekend
Date - Go smell the flowers together

2928203362.DescriptionEn: Your fortune this time is a modest blessing! Congratulations! You've already picked a modest blessing, so all that's left is to pick a better fortune!

2307433907.DescriptionEn: This year is going to be a good year too! However, in the cold winter, pay more attention to your health! Don't forget to wash your hands and brush your teeth!

3879409653.DescriptionEn: We support you giving it your best. We hope you have another great year! ♪

2475099392.DescriptionEn:
Friendship - Get more friends
Lost Item - Find it right next to you
Study - Accomplish desired achievements

1939176149.DescriptionEn: Drum roll! Your fortune this time is a blessing! Today is now perfect!

226724583.DescriptionEn: It's not a great blessing, but it's close! Spend the rest of the day with a happy smile on your face!

422101479.DescriptionEn:
Bullets - Won't get shot
Troublemakers - Won't meet any
Today - Hope it's a happy day

2677997047.DescriptionEn:
Wish - Will come true
Money - Your wallet will overflow
Encounter - Finally meet the person you were waiting for

2043188119.DescriptionEn: You chose a great blessing! You are the superstar of the year! Congratulations!

266718355.DescriptionEn: It's your lucky day! Luck will follow you, and your business will flourish! Your lucky color for the day is beautiful blue!

1124846343.DescriptionEn: Your fortune is a great blessing! Congratulations! The bold challenges you take on will be successful, and everything you do will work out! Believe in yourself and move forward! You got this!

964504315.DescriptionEn: Today's Grocery List: 1 can of cream stew, 250g of chicken, 2 potatoes, 3 onions, 1 carrot, 1 bunch of broccoli, 1 bottle of citron vinegar...

199728885.DescriptionEn: You have to be careful to avoid food poisoning! I've never had it before though. Anyway, how about some chocolate sea cucumber juice?

1759134687.DescriptionEn: There's no surefire way to recover crushed ingredients. You'll have to boil them and then grind them in a blender to make soup.

4232612005.DescriptionEn: I was carrying food, but I fell and spilled it... At least I found a coin right where I fell.

2722903738.DescriptionEn: The Future Blessing fortune! Even if you lose now, you'll gain later... Hmm. I wanna eat something, like dango...

2264344015.DescriptionEn: Let's see... Future Blessing! I'll give you the mint octopus pudding I made as a prize!

3089424248.DescriptionEn: Undercooked food isn't too bad since you can always cook it for longer. Overcooked, burnt food is the real problem.

1618617468.DescriptionEn: The person who gets this fortune will be lucky...but also suffer. Like finding gold after digging up an entire mountain. Heeheehee. Well, a gourmand's journey is bound to be seasoned by hardship.

839518806.DescriptionEn: A Future Blessing is a sign that you'll become lucky later. Who knows what the future will bring?

239549900.DescriptionEn: Happy news will come in the fall and winter. That's now! Not so lucky in the spring and summer, though...

3417604566.DescriptionEn: The Small Blessing! You'll easily overcome a looming crisis. If you remain on an even path, you'll be at peace... Hmm, I think this is good!

3872470199.DescriptionEn: This is the Small Blessing. It's said that happiness really comes from the small things. Like the rain may stop as soon as you step outside!

4154538605.DescriptionEn: The fortune this time is the Small Blessing! Even if you get confused boarding the subway, you'll get onto the right one!

1652241604.DescriptionEn: They say you need to look to the stars to chart your course. Not the lights on all the passing ships.

2851981489.DescriptionEn: May good luck come from hidden encounters. Look forward to opening your eyes... Does this mean my cooking skills will improve?

228389323.DescriptionEn: Let's collect the ingredients one by one until the meal can be made!

3038779302.DescriptionEn:
Love - Eye contact with the person you like
Meet - That person at a festival on the weekend
Date - Go watch fireworks together

284642160.DescriptionEn: Your fortune is the Modest Blessing. Congrats. Sometimes I wish I could eat until I was so full, that I couldn't eat anymore.

2426075748.DescriptionEn: The moon is bright and clear, with no place for dark clouds... Lunch would be even more delicious under the moonlight. Heeheehee.

1325967005.DescriptionEn: If food is the most important necessity of life, luck is a close second. It's the Modest Blessing. Congratulations.

4022503532.DescriptionEn: Something will turn into happiness. One arrow will hit two geese... I wonder if roasted goose is good.

2197323664.DescriptionEn: You'll survive at the crossroads of life and death. The journey may be difficult, but the destination is auspicious. You'll eat delicious food in the New Year. That's nice to hear!

294425413.DescriptionEn:
Meet - The person you're waiting for
Happiness - Will come
Help someone if they're feeling vulnerable

2086697042.DescriptionEn: With this fortune, you'll advance if you have the right mindset. With a bad outlook, though, things won't go well.

657860840.DescriptionEn: There's nothing more gratifying than everyone enjoying the food I make. May you always be lucky this year!

128516439.DescriptionEn: Sensei. It's the Blessing fortune. A single arrow flies across the blue sky, and a deer travels a thousand miles alone... Won't this deer get hungry, though?

2382060588.DescriptionEn: With this fortune, you're like a flower blooming on an old tree. From now on, much joy will come... For me, I hope that I'll have at least one peaceful day...

370799142.DescriptionEn: For those with good fortune I've made osechi, which is said to be full of blessings for the New Year. Have some before you go!

1512780410.DescriptionEn:
Meet - Under the legendary tree
Moving - Things will improve
Food - Eat as much as you want on the main street

997253011.DescriptionEn: Wow, the Great Blessing. Heeheehee. I wonder what kind of gourmet food is waiting for us this year.

940731399.DescriptionEn:
In the spring of the willow,
flowers bloom on old branches.
In the heavy frost and snow,
a golden sheen shines even brighter.

555506678.DescriptionEn: Fortune comes like a wave, and turns into a full box of osechi and well-cooked snapper... I especially like the latter!

3840660582.DescriptionEn:
You got the Great Blessing. Congrats. I guarantee special news will come.
*Watch out for imitations.

1744408890.DescriptionEn: A gem without a single flaw. Keep polishing it and you'll be even luckier... Yes, I'm gonna devote myself to cooking even more!

1664341587.DescriptionEn:
This strange curry is a very suspicious color.
Its chemical-like smell stings the nose.
Even the rice it is served with is burnt and bitter.

408873372.DescriptionEn:
Curry made with leftover fish head added in an attempt to enhance the flavor.
It did its job, but the curry ended up with a strange fishy smell.
Guaranteed to bring a frown to anyone's face.

3557467288.DescriptionEn:
A simple curry made with pumpkin, potatoes, and carrots.
It's nothing special, but the sweetness of the vegetables goes well with the curry.
The white rice it's served with is well-cooked.

817877395.DescriptionEn:
Delicious curry topped with large shrimp.
The light taste of shrimp blends smoothly with the creamy sauce.
The spices balance the heaviness perfectly.

2465534331.DescriptionEn:
A sumptuous curry with top-quality sirloin steak over rice.
The texture of the grilled mushrooms and green onions adds variety to the dish.
The garlic rice stir-fried with butter is its own delicacy in itself.

3616003768.DescriptionEn: (whiff) I'm used to it... But next time...!

3854794868.DescriptionEn: Seems like you've lost your form. Be sure to check yourself for injuries.

2662227242.DescriptionEn: Ch-Cheer up...? I'll cheer for you!

170702207.DescriptionEn: I like it when people say participating is what matters. I do want to win, though...

4162217022.DescriptionEn: In sports or in training, getting started is halfway to getting it done.

2680245513.DescriptionEn: We're finally getting started! Keep your chin up until the end!

1958845128.DescriptionEn: It's a prize to encourage you to keep going. You've got to get base hits before you can hit a home run!

2791568111.DescriptionEn: Hmm, I see. Don't let your guard down after finishing a set. Let's get one more in!

461611471.DescriptionEn: When you feel like giving in, that's when you need some cheering on!

1428247863.DescriptionEn: They say a good portion of base hits come from luck. And if you practice, you can make the most of that luck.

752868706.DescriptionEn: Luck doesn't make much of a difference in training, but in sports, it seems like a different story.

2640635459.DescriptionEn: You have to be prepared...otherwise, you'll miss out on your good luck!

2984517236.DescriptionEn: Ugh...! That was so close! I mean, 2nd place is incredible, but...! It's like hitting a double in baseball!

1431221238.DescriptionEn: An incredible result! Let's not let up, and keep making our way to the top!

1980863458.DescriptionEn: Keep it up! Incredible! Keep going, just a bit more!

1686581353.DescriptionEn: This is a...! It's a home run! And it won't be the last!

4080298096.DescriptionEn: We finally made it. But every end is another beginning. Keep that in mind for tomorrow.

4164991921.DescriptionEn: Woo hoo! I'm so happy, I'm almost crying here! These are the moments you cheer for!

2670560256.DescriptionEn: It's Silver Plate, the demon merchant and Era's loyal servant! They're an exceptionally wicked being that appears through a dimensional rift to sell items that make people unhappy! In the spinoff "Johnny Kivotos and High-Caliber Magic," they even become the formidable main villain! Nevertheless, they remain a fan-favorite among the hardcore, and have been known to have entire booths dedicated to them at Magicaliber-con! While they may appear weak, they have a special "pyramid power" that renders most attacks useless. In episode 11 of season 2, Silver Plate uses a camouflage tool and comes as a transfer student, where—

2818922347.DescriptionEn: It's Stanag, the cute mascot of the Magicaliber series! They make a Magical National Guard contract with White and Pink and turn them into magical girls! Era's evil knights loathe Stanag's kindness and purity, so they kidnap and bully Stanag on a daily basis! But Stanag stays resilient and never loses their bright smile! They also support the magical girls by supplying magical bullets when they're in danger! From Green tip to black tip, they have an impressive array of ammunition! I was so touched by the episode when Stanag had an awakening. I think it was episode 7 of season 2, where Stanag's original form—

3074909671.NameEn: О, рыцари зла, настало время тьмы!
3074909671.DescriptionEn: Era! When I was young and saw her for the first time, I was so scared that I could barely peek through my fingertips to watch! She's the incredibly pretty, yet scary, nemesis of Heavy Caliber! When the sound of love and happiness from our world reached Era's dark planet, she gathered a team of evil villains and ambushed Heavy Caliber, vowing to silence our happy world forever! But the thing is, Era is also super loud when she laughs! Despite constantly being defeated by Heavy Caliber, she's a scary villain who never gives up! In the movie Magical Girl Heavy Caliber - Daisy Cutter, there's a scene where Era loses her memories and works as an ordinary bookstore part-timer, where Era—

907100893.DescriptionEn: Thermite Pink! She's White's loyal sidekick! If you're curious as to why she's purple despite her name being Pink, then... Ah! It might be a spoiler, so I recommend you watch the main story! Pink used to be a bit of an outsider student. But when White protected her from Era's attacks, she admired White for being cool and strong, and Pink ended up entering a contract with the Magical National Guard! And the two became the best duo in history of magical girls! While working with White, with the power of love, friendship, and some firepower, Pink was able to regain her confidence and turned into an amazing character! In episode 6 of season 3 where they turned into band idol superstars—

3133177365.NameEn: Апостол мира! Предоставьте это Термит Уайт!
3133177365.DescriptionEn: Thermite White is, and always will be, the main protagonist of the Magicaliber series! She used to be an ordinary, clumsy girl. But then, when Era was attacking, she met Stanag, the icon from the magical kingdom! While she was scared and shaking, our righteous White entered a contract with the Magical National Guard and became a magical girl! And Pink, who was saved by White, also becomes a magical girl, and the two become Magical Girl Heavy Caliber, the magical girls of justice who protect the world! In episode 2 of season 2, when White runs into Dragon Skin, one of the minions—

3560225627.DescriptionEn: Ramen claiming to be seafood-based. Its flavors are so overwhelming that it makes one feel sorry for the chopsticks that must repeatedly dive into the broth. The sheer creativity required to turn delicious ingredients into something this inedible is striking.

1070674443.DescriptionEn: Shoyu-based ramen with a clear broth. It's known for its extremely light taste. However, it's so light that one might overlook the flavor if they don't focus on tasting every sip.

2956567346.DescriptionEn: Ramen with a delicious aroma, topped with black garlic oil. A sip of broth coats your mouth in savory garlic. Try not to be intimidated by its appearance and give it a taste.

2787024907.DescriptionEn: Tonkotsu ramen with every available topping piled high. The rich toppings harmonize with the deep flavor of the broth to create a symphony of delight. It's a ramen that rarely disappoints, making it everyone's go-to order.

4270783877.DescriptionEn: Ramen armed with an overwhelming size and colossal calories. The ingredients were bravely added without a moment of hesitation, adding to the bowl's charming excessiveness. The gilded flower is also edible.

1462360932.DescriptionEn: This square is used as a rest area and meeting place. It's the perfect place for a stroll.

4293010634.DescriptionEn: A business district is located next to Tri-Square. It's a modern and stylish space with complex streets and buildings.

1977010791.DescriptionEn: The street where the huge art gallery is located. Besides that, the avenue itself is full of art. It's a must-see.

1729072075.DescriptionEn: Despite the size of the park, there aren't many visitors. It's still an important attraction.

2590301450.DescriptionEn: If you want to see the beach, you should come here...but the scenery might not be quite what you're imagining.

526288530.DescriptionEn:
The perfect headset for maids and agents. It's noise-cancelling and has special technology for processing audio. It's even hackproof!
For Toki, it's an item that represents her relationship with someone very precious to her.

2538736248.DescriptionEn: A coin that Koyuki drilled a hole in. It was originally made so that she could play arcade machines for free, but it's now useless because of modern card readers.

2108207432.DescriptionEn: A doll that Umika bought at her first festival. It came as a pair.

510297897.DescriptionEn:
Eri's witch hat, which could be seen as an extension of Eri herself.

172883371.DescriptionEn: Chise's favorite kind of wind chime. Its clear, crisp sound is said to signal the arrival of a cool breeze.

2878555129.DescriptionEn: A notepad used by Junko. It's a special journal in which she records the scores of every great restaurant she has been to, organized by area.

2856730141.DescriptionEn: A limited reprint of a manga collection. Even when everyone disagrees, if it's important to one person, then it's an important item.

1977526069.DescriptionEn:
A pair of special glasses that Kotori always wears.

3126054698.DescriptionEn:

An ordinary book with nothing special about it.

741491105.DescriptionEn: Dango dipped in chocolate sold at a famous traditional candy store. The harmony of flavors tastes surprisingly great.

3042768744.DescriptionEn: Whale-shaped chocolate sold as a souvenir at the Maritime Museum. It's much larger than the other chocolate fish.

1510394578.DescriptionEn: Rose-shaped chocolate sold at the Abydos station. They're based on desert rose stones and make for a popular gift.

2394567841.DescriptionEn: Risque chocolates for adults. They don't seem to be very popular due to their explicit shape.

367299249.DescriptionEn: A wiretapping device made by Kotama to look like chocolate. It doesn't seem like she wants it to be discreet.

919440775.DescriptionEn: A chocolate-flavored canned drink mainly sold in vending machines. The heat from the can helps warm the body.

3490934017.DescriptionEn: A chocolate gift set that Yuuka bought for Sensei. Although it's premium chocolate that costs over 10,000 yen, it comes with a receipt stating it costs 5,000 yen for some reason.

3659962553.DescriptionEn: A homemade chocolate item by Aris based on a slime monster from a game. Its appearance leaves much to be desired.

941224173.DescriptionEn: A chocolate-flavored Frenzy MAX sold for the Valentine's Day season. It tastes nasty, but it has an excellent energizing effect.

1781832965.DescriptionEn: A spray that dispenses chocolate instead of ink. It can be used to sweeten up the world according to Maki.

2579538323.DescriptionEn: Chocolate made in the shape of a screw and covered in silver foil. It cannot be used as a tool despite its striking resemblance to a real screw.

3469911388.DescriptionEn: Red Winter Academy's special milk chocolate produced by the Red Winter School Lunch Club. Cherino has already taken a bite of it.

1188251464.DescriptionEn: An improved version of the standard Cherenka with a cute illustration drawn by Tomoe. It tastes almost exactly the same as original Cherenka.

3845682331.DescriptionEn: A cacao bean that Nodoka barely managed to afford and intended to give to Sensei as a gift. It's not sweet, but it has a good flavor when brewed like tea.

711391590.DescriptionEn: Haniwa-shaped chocolate prepared by Hanako. It's a bit creepy.

2407160249.DescriptionEn: Chocolate from Hina made by courageously overcoming her shyness. It doesn't look pretty, but the heart that went into making it is more beautiful than anything else.

1422578612.DescriptionEn: Chocolate made with ingredients carefully selected by Ako. She purposefully made chocolate that can be consumed habitually, just as good secretaries approach their work.

87498756.DescriptionEn: Chocolate made from ingredients that Izumi thinks are the best for chocolate. Delicious according to Izumi. It is especially salty and savory.

1899678676.DescriptionEn: The finest chocolate, purchased online by Aru to show appreciation for Sensei's work as her business partner...though, it's actually quite common. Still, it's the thought that counts.

171489856.DescriptionEn: Prank chocolate that lit up Mutsuki's eyes when she found it online. The unlucky winner gets a taste of hell. It's the perfect product for pranking friends.

2099851060.DescriptionEn: Hot cocoa that Fuuka made for Sensei. It's warm and sentimental, and you can feel Fuuka's sweet kindness emanate from it.

1852286999.DescriptionEn: Homemade chocolate for Sensei that Juri gave everything she had to make. Taste aside, Juri's sincerity can be felt just by looking at it.

1269992298.DescriptionEn: The finest chocolate cake that Serika received from a part-time job she worked with Sensei. The taste of the sweet and fluffy cake is mixed with the taste of the sweat they'd shed together working.

265930468.DescriptionEn: A gift set of chocolate candies bought at a department store with Sensei. It makes for the best Valentine's Day gift because it contains an assortment of candy that one never tires of.

689413464.DescriptionEn: The best product that Sumire found after testing 100 different exercise supplements for Sensei. You'll feel full for the entire day after just one serving.

3328209817.DescriptionEn: Chocolate with a toy that Momoi pulled from a crane game. A mascot character from the popular fighting game "The Fist of Cassiopeia - Upalupa Great Battle" is included. There are seven types in total.

3385816833.DescriptionEn: Homemade chocolate that Midori woke up early to make for Sensei. Wanting to be the first person to give chocolate to Sensei, her heart was warm and puffed up with anticipation while making it.

3589704604.DescriptionEn: Slightly strange chocolate crackers prepared by Chise that contain various idioms. Most of the content is normal, but on rare occasions, you may get one with something absurd written on it.

3842989732.DescriptionEn: A limited-edition dessert sold by Momoyodou in celebration of Valentine's Day. It is a special item that reflects the preferences of a certain regular customer. In other words, it's mostly made for Sensei.

3251730635.DescriptionEn: A set of various chocolate must-have ninja tools. Izuna wanted to taste it with her lord and managed to get by standing in line early in the morning. Note: Cannot actually be used as tools.

4247091559.DescriptionEn: A sleeping kit for Valentine's Day prepared specifically by Tsubaki for Sensei, who is always tired from overtime work. It costs 3,980 yen in total.

2771361458.DescriptionEn: Homemade chocolate made with Wakamo's overflowing, uncontrollable love. However, it is uncertain if love really is the only thing it's made of.

1572630441.DescriptionEn: Matcha-flavored chocolate that Haruna made with Sensei to prove a theory about gourmet chocolate. You can taste the bitterness as well as the sweetness that comes from her grateful heart.

3743008500.DescriptionEn: A chocolate version of "Skullman, the Grim Reaper" prepared by Azusa. This is a limited-edition item that can only be obtained during the Valentine's Day season.

1084418779.DescriptionEn: Famous chocolate brought by Koharu. A premium mixture of white and dark chocolate, it's known for the cross in the center.

2742248602.DescriptionEn: Star-shaped chocolate that Suzumi bought at a convenience store. It is wrapped in gilt and shines brightly.

663608497.DescriptionEn: A Sister figure gifted by Mari. It's made of chocolate. It may have been for display rather than for eating.

848260985.DescriptionEn: Special chocolate in the shape of beads so that chocolate doesn't get on your hands or leave crumbs. It is popular among avid readers, including Shimiko.

1900401189.DescriptionEn: Serina's homemade chocolate. The sweet taste calms the heart.

4183660781.DescriptionEn: A specially-processed chocolate mint prepared by Airi. It's often gifted among enthusiasts due to its rarity.

1868703267.DescriptionEn: Yoshimi's homemade chocolate. Can be considered a limited edition that cannot be seen anywhere else.

355355427.DescriptionEn: Chocolate seemingly made by Natsu. It's a rather simple design and is intended to be a substitute for much of Natsu's speech.

2098665142.DescriptionEn: Fated chocolate that Chinatsu prepared. Various phrases are written inside.

3487183095.DescriptionEn: Chocolate Sena made whenever she could find time while on call. She couldn't find any wrapping paper, so she wrapped it in a clean bandage instead.

3066393242.DescriptionEn: Very expensive chocolate Haruka bought for Sensei. You may be a good fit for Problem Solver 68 if the 99.99% cacao rating doesn't faze you.

3579363383.DescriptionEn: Chocolate Asuna prepared for her master for Valentine's Day. It underwent a very minor modification during the making process.

304962670.DescriptionEn: Akane's homemade chocolate. The chocolate is very well made, showing off her skills as a maid.

1933815846.DescriptionEn: Omurice prepared by Karin for Valentine's Day. A heart is drawn on the omurice with chocolate instead of ketchup.

1957428602.DescriptionEn: A chocolate engraving of a dragon that Neru brought. There's no way to find out how or where she got it.

1255509912.DescriptionEn: Chocolate made by Kotori to explain the origin and significance of Valentine's Day. Although it looks shabby, it tastes great.

1303875154.DescriptionEn: Chocolate in the shape of a drinking glass brought by Pina. Since it is a Valentine's Day souvenir, it is not actually a drinking glass, and you cannot fill it with alcohol.

1082089594.DescriptionEn: Chocolate-covered almonds left by Tsurugi. The glass bottle is tied with a cute red ribbon.

3411154794.DescriptionEn: Handmade chocolate wrapped clumsily by Kokona, though she'll never admit it was her handiwork. You'd better eat it alone, while no one's watching.

421170184.DescriptionEn: Chocolate truffles that Hinata keeps on hand to give to children who visit the cathedral. Hinata apparently knows the flavor of every type of truffle.

412848971.DescriptionEn: Chocolate chip cookies made by Ui. She says that she used a recipe that doesn't leave crumbs.

1622643101.DescriptionEn: A slice of chocolate cake topped with fresh strawberries. Kazusa spent a lot of time picking it out, so please respect that.

2747826200.DescriptionEn: A small, neatly-wrapped Valentine chocolate. Hiyori says she's given up everything for it.

2837160480.DescriptionEn: An exceedingly well-wrapped Valentine chocolate. The complicated wrapper seems to reflect Misaki's personality.

4062180493.DescriptionEn: Handmade chocolate and flowers personally grown by Atsuko. A princess is sure to have many secrets.

3932209420.DescriptionEn: The finest of chocolates prepared by Saori. Many happenings occurred behind the scenes in the process of their creation.

2263489181.DescriptionEn: Mimori's special Cherry Blossom White Chocolate. They say Mimori pours her very heart into making it. As for the other rumor...it probably has nothing to do with mind reading. Probably.

170445747.DescriptionEn: The ultimate chocosaur, created by Kaede. Unfortunately, she didn't manage to successfully "excavate" any of her fossil chocolates, but the experience inspired her. She combined the remaining pieces of chocolate together to create this. "It's the strongest dinosaur in history!" - Kaede.

566203770.DescriptionEn: Tsukuyo's cute Holland Lop Rabbit character chocolate. She may have been holding it a bit too close, and the shape has changed a little...

2104744538.NameEn: Шоколад утонченной и прекрасной супергениальной хакерши
2104744538.DescriptionEn: A chocolate made by Himari in her own image. After much logical deliberation, she made the rational decision that you needed to go back to Schale to eat it.

3304317128.DescriptionEn: Handmade chocolate breadsticks made by Iroha. One of them has a small mark on it...

902334212.NameEn: Набор шоколадных значков Клуба исследований ниндзюцу
902334212.DescriptionEn: A special chocolate custom-ordered by Michiru. She fumbled and stumbled her way through the gift-giving process, but her love for her classmates and her respect for Sensei couldn't be clearer.

813659355.DescriptionEn: Miyako baked this carrot cake with lots of chocolate. Aren't very sweet foods supposed to be bad for rabbits, though?

490342082.DescriptionEn: Chocolate s'mores made by Moe. The calories in this sweet marshmallow and chocolate combo are...destructive.

1288390774.DescriptionEn: A chocolate caramel ration that Saki gave you. It's popular among guards on duty at night who need help staying awake. Saki herself assured you many times that it has nothing to do with Valentine's Day.

1222376462.DescriptionEn: A handmade chocolate bark from Miyu. She was supplied some chocolate and mixed it with fruit she gathered from the mountains. Why are the chocolate pieces all shaped like leaves, though?

4196510691.DescriptionEn: Chocolate ink that Noa bought, possibly as a joke. It's not practical for writing, as it doesn't transfer well to quills and spoils easily, but it's perfect if you want to make a statement about your feelings.

70201916.DescriptionEn: A chocolate medal awarded to Marina for her contribution to the Cherenka. It's a testament to Marina's hard work and pride.

967689799.DescriptionEn: A non-alcoholic chocolate cocktail mixed by Shigure. The trick is to add a square of bittersweet chocolate at the end for a clean, balanced taste.

3442222452.DescriptionEn: Chocolates that Mine swears are medical supplies. If this is medicine, it's strangely delicious, and the packaging is unusually cute.

18239407.DescriptionEn: A snack Ayumu enjoys, chunks of dried grapefruit dipped in chocolate. Since it has caffeine, theobromine, and plenty of vitamins, it should help with feeling fatigued... Or something like that.

390594649.DescriptionEn: Chocolate Ichika made for Sensei. It's shaped like a stick for convenient eating. Despite looking very amateurish, it appears and tastes just as good as a store-bought chocolate.

3418867182.DescriptionEn: A giant chocolate almost as big as a real slipper and much sturdier than it looks. You could probably even take a walk in it.

3006306790.DescriptionEn: A set of homemade chocolates Koyuki sent to Sensei. It might seem like a normal chocolate gift, but in true Koyuki fashion, it comes with a hidden message.

291186913.DescriptionEn: A premium chocolate set Sakurako got for Sensei. She painstakingly chose the best place to source this rare and valuable gift from.

498190404.DescriptionEn: Reisa's chocolate in the form of a letter. It's actually just a big piece of chocolate with an envelope on top. There must be a letter from Reisa inside...

2827551265.DescriptionEn: Megu's special homemade chocolate. Despite the stark resemblance to hot springs eggs, don't get confused! She's made enough for everyone, so help yourself.

2152153824.DescriptionEn: Rumi made these chocolate moon cakes just for Sensei. Her immaculate skills are on display with the variety of styles and flavors.

219184488.DescriptionEn: A chocolate that Mina made based on her "most important thing." Her sentiment was clearly a good one, but it's hard to escape the feeling that something is amiss.

717036626.DescriptionEn: A keychain and chocolate that Momiji claims she happened to win somewhere. Apparently by coincidence, Momiji has her own matching pair.

2219659309.DescriptionEn: Nagisa's homemade chocolate, created with gratitude for Sensei. It's intentionally simple to avoid any kind of misunderstandings. However, the taste and quality of the chocolate far surpasses any store-bought product.

2751216385.DescriptionEn: Minori's solution to not being able to actually celebrate Valentine's day. While she claims she's giving it out of obligation, she actually put quite a bit of care into picking out the brand.

2983078984.DescriptionEn: A small box of chocolates Aoi made for Sensei. The diverse selection suggests Aoi painstakingly made each type to make sure she made at least one to Sensei's taste.

3666669973.DescriptionEn: A chocolate that Plana meticulously made without telling Arona. It tastes just the way Sensei likes it.

967746156.DescriptionEn: A piece of white chocolate featuring an image of Meru, by Meru. She seems concerned with the way it turned out, but the real concern seems to be where to start eating...

3706730641.NameEn: Лучший, величайший, ультимативный домашний шоколадный торт
3706730641.DescriptionEn: Homemade chocolate cake that's claimed to rival that of the most famous bakery in Kivotos. Toki says her tagline for it is the best, greatest, ultimate.

2168519091.DescriptionEn: Homemade chocolate Kaho made for Sensei. At first glance, it looks like a simple promotional item, but each letter was carefully carved by hand with dedication and care.

3486261893.DescriptionEn: An average cup of joe Kanna made for Sensei. But rather unusually, it boasts a sweet, chocolate flavor, thanks perhaps to Kanna's brewing methods.

1766939933.DescriptionEn: Renge's homemade raw chocolate, perfected with help from Sensei. Although clumsily made and not refined, the chocolates hold precious memories.

2005226182.DescriptionEn: Chocolate Kikyou made for Sensei. It features a cute cat face that doesn't quite match its bland name. Maybe its hinting at a secret operation...or something?

3801373544.DescriptionEn: Yukari went to the shopping district at the crack of dawn for this limited edition chocolate corn stick and paired it with a handmade amulet. This heartwarming gift is the embodiment of her passion as both a Kadenokouji and a Hyakkaryouran member.

3081511179.DescriptionEn: Chocolate pudding personally made by Ibuki herself. She might have put a little too much love into it, as it appears to be inundated with different toppings and sweets. Watch your sugar levels if you eat the whole thing!

1270452267.DescriptionEn: A chocolate roll cake Mika baked for Sensei. It's a bit clumsily made, but full of heart and a testament to Mika's hard work.

3269210663.DescriptionEn: A top-of-the-line chocolate fountain machine that Makoto had specially made for Sensei. She may have been a little overly ambitious with its features, however, as the various modifications caused it to start spraying chocolate every which way.

1875831713.DescriptionEn: A palanquin-shaped chocolate that Umika earnestly made for Sensei. There's something truly precious sitting inside it.

2689554198.DescriptionEn: Kirara suffered many failures while trying to make this crepe. There can be no numerical measure put on its value and sincerity.

960286300.DescriptionEn: A chocolate that the other Shiroko once gave you, but in large quantity this time. It carries all her earnest feelings, besides the many worries that she quietly shoulders.

3431574551.DescriptionEn: Kisaki made use of her skills learned from her tea ceremony hobby to brew this Cacao Nibs Tea. The perfect balance of bitter and nutty flavor contrasting with the thick scent of chocolate is impressive.

2259933796.DescriptionEn: Iron Palm Chocolate that Reijo made with a "special method." The clear shape of a fist engraved into it belongs to her.

3142750909.DescriptionEn: Coin-shaped, handmade chocolates presented inside a luxurious box. Satsuki made these with her own secret recipe in hopes of cultivating a closer sense of intimacy with Sensei.

1486627927.DescriptionEn: A polaroid photo of a luxurious and beautiful chocolate. However, the actual chocolate that came with it is dented and messy for some reason.

491306207.DescriptionEn: Seia's chocolate. It also came with a receipt that shines in gold. Be careful signing without reading the fine print.

782661412.DescriptionEn: Rio's chocolate that has Millennium Science School's emblem engraved to it. She claims it was made with the most logical and rational process possible.

1094002594.DescriptionEn: A glove, a bat, and a baseball. They say you can play ball with anyone as long as you have these. Making chocolate versions of these items shows that the giver is quite dedicated.

506164489.DescriptionEn: A brand new snack from Hikari. You can't even fathom what it tastes like... But it's very sweet of her to offer it as a gift despite being tempted to eat it herself.

1272169695.DescriptionEn: Gummies filled with essential nutrients. Perhaps this is the perfect gift for an overworked Sensei.

1649572559.DescriptionEn: Ordinary store-bought chocolate in a slightly crumpled paper bag. And the crumpled note says...

3907944625.DescriptionEn: Chocolate cookies from Ebisu sold throughout the Hyakkiyako district. They're well known for their exquisite crunch thanks to their thin white chocolate coating. Unfortunately, the coating melts easily...

950107355.DescriptionEn: An alleged box of chocolates in a fancy box. There's just one handmade chocolate inside it. While it may not be as expected, it's nevertheless a masterpiece imbued with Niya's playful spirit.

2522956263.DescriptionEn: Wrapped chocolate shapes that Eri claims are infused with mana. Every bite makes you feel more reenergized.

3646064924.DescriptionEn: A muffin topped with a cute white chocolate ghost decoration. One look at it, and you can swear you hear Kanoe's voice.

1600461265.DescriptionEn: A tiramisu that tastes even better after being chilled. Still, the conversation shared during that wait might be even sweeter.

788496083.DescriptionEn: A candy that's so large and hard that you have to break it into pieces just to eat it. Try rolling it around in your mouth and savoring its sweetness.

2100977290.DescriptionEn: It's huge, doesn't melt, and also possesses a certain artistic value. Aside from the fact that you can't eat it, it's aesthetically perfect chocolate.

2647895027.DescriptionEn: It looks like common store-bought chocolate, but there's something special about it. It's said to be highly collectible.

1217736606.DescriptionEn:
Cookies made by mixing cocoa powder into meringue.
The giver knows that such ingredients are precious commodities.

165942245.DescriptionEn:
Chocolate desserts made by blending condensed milk, sugar, cocoa, cinnamon powder, and other ingredients into molasses cookie crumbs.
Every bite holds limitless potential.

1366975366.DescriptionEn:
A cake made by layering chocolate cake sheets, honey, and chocolate cream.
As always, it reminds you that negotiations and contracts are important.

4174179093.DescriptionEn:
Chocolates that the giver claims to have purchased off the shelf from a regular store.
Sometimes, you have to act oblivious even if you know the truth.

Grilled corn prepared by the Gourmet Research Society.

1254096944.DescriptionEn:
Seized by the Prefect Team from a troublemaker at the beach.
Signs of a helpless struggle remain.

104149602.DescriptionEn:
Seized by the Prefect Team from a Splashy Helmet Gang hoodlum in the beachside slums.
Signs of a futile struggle remain.

3708418519.DescriptionEn: A human-shaped root herb found deep in the mountains of Shanhaijing. It's said to have effects that prolong your life or make you younger.

4012080640.DescriptionEn: President Cherino's favorite Red Winter Academy special shampoo. Contrary to the name, it's not suitable for washing a mustache.

2585452848.DescriptionEn: A bath bomb in the shape of a capybara. When you put it in water, it melts and gives off a subtle citrus scent.

2887327615.DescriptionEn: Bags of trash collected from various places while on Valentine's Day patrol. Beautification activities are always rewarding.

2333680348.DescriptionEn: Boxes of materials have been dumped all over the abandoned resort. They've been there for a long time, so it's unknown what's inside.

923224583.DescriptionEn: The local currency of the Lost Paradise Resort, which was created for the purpose of revitalizing tourism. It's unknown if it's really legitimate, but Shizuko says it's only a matter of time before she can prove it.

1459837138.DescriptionEn: Coins that can be exchanged for souvenirs at the Momoyodou Beach Shack. However, most of the customers seem to think of the coin itself as a souvenir.

2503861371.DescriptionEn: A conch with a smooth and silky exterior. Chise says that if you put it to your ear and listen, you'll be naturally inspired to write poetry.

3295998236.DescriptionEn: A scroll with various original ninjutsus that can be used in summer. There are many writings related to summer safety. Safety comes first, even for ninjas!

4253247347.NameEn: Билет на курорт острова глубоководных горячих источников

2442357514.DescriptionEn: Resort agreement that gives the holder right to use the Mushiqueen Cruise Resort.

4133487383.DescriptionEn: Resort agreement that gives the holder right to use the Ultra Luxury Resort.

125540590.DescriptionEn: A coupon issued at a famous dessert shop. Collect and take them to the shop. There's a specific dessert that can be acquired with a certain number of coupons.

3387762043.DescriptionEn: A mint chocolate parfait with a unique taste. It's fresh and sweet at the same time.

806537948.DescriptionEn: Macarons that fit in the palm of your hand. There are so many different flavors!

336149210.DescriptionEn: A chocolate-flavored snack that's rolled up into a long, hollow piece. Some students put it in their mouth and shake it to look cool.

2418932586.DescriptionEn: These points are earned each time you progress in an event. The more you earn, the greater the variety of rewards you can receive.

1469297879.DescriptionEn: A baton used in relays. Don't worry; while it looks like an old stick hand grenade, it's actually been retrofitted with an electrical sensor that prevents it from exploding. As long as it's handed off to the next runner in time, that is.

4179360865.DescriptionEn: Red-and-white candy shaped like a cane. It smells like peppermint.

1459661267.DescriptionEn: A hot drink made with milk, eggs, and sugar. It's sure to warm you up on even the coldest day.

3707337679.DescriptionEn: A fish that is a necessity for an osechi meal, paired with shrimp. Celebrate New Year's right with some delicious snapper!

2091304235.DescriptionEn: Everyone says that it's just for fun, but it still feels a bit ominous when you get a bad one...

2629342802.DescriptionEn: A piece of a computational device from the Ark of Atrahasis. The circuits that make it up are incomprehensibly complicated.

1015134010.DescriptionEn: A piece of the Dimension Engine. On its own, it's a simple piece of machinery and doesn't seem very useful.

3353425290.DescriptionEn: A choco-burger that was vacuum-packed to use as a space ration. Exactly why something like that might be found here is up for debate even now.
