2995130259.DescriptionEn: A chip where the code to open the Outer District 3 gate is stored.

1012273839.DescriptionEn: A chip where the code to open the Central District gate is stored.

636205895.DescriptionEn: Momoka's favorite snack. The salty flavor makes your mouth water.

832973929.DescriptionEn: Keeping a clean headband is all a part of a competent maid's job!

3488365730.DescriptionEn: This makeup palette might seem basic, but with a skilled enough hand it can create any disguise.

1069023790.DescriptionEn: An invitation to the old mansion. There have been rumors of supernatural occurrences at this historic site...

611002646.DescriptionEn: A bundle of game cards popular in Shanhaijing. The more you collect, the more games you can play.

133960514.DescriptionEn: A solvent extraction set they say can be used by anyone. Rumor is the Plum Blossom Garden is particularly reluctant to purchase it.

759180874.DescriptionEn: A starfish that's been left out on the dock to dry out. It can't be eaten and doesn't decay easily, so they are considered a nuisance by the villagers. Still, Miyu seems to feel a strange sense of kinship to it.

3530266131.DescriptionEn: This ticket guarantees the results of a dice roll in Dice Race. This ticket will disappear when you choose 2 as your Guaranteed Roll.

1850902797.DescriptionEn: This ticket guarantees the results of a dice roll in Dice Race. This ticket will disappear when you choose 3 as your Guaranteed Roll.

3420182781.DescriptionEn: This ticket guarantees the results of a dice roll in Dice Race. This ticket will disappear when you choose 4 as your Guaranteed Roll.

819189154.DescriptionEn: This ticket guarantees the results of a dice roll in Dice Race. This ticket will disappear when you choose 5 as your Guaranteed Roll.

392753185.DescriptionEn: It feels exactly like using pen and paper...according to the ad copy.

342544352.DescriptionEn: A train crew whistle. Perfect for shattering the peace of everyone around you.

3819866792.DescriptionEn: A weird wire that can only be found in the Millennium Ruins. It is in good condition.

1268221723.DescriptionEn: Binoculars to allow for a clear view of the stage no matter where you are in the venue. Elevate your viewing experience if you weren't lucky enough to get front row seats!

3685108562.DescriptionEn: A natural born fighter with the spirit of a shark. Like Makoto, it relentlessly searches for opponents to challenge. Its hunger can only be satiated by formidable fights, endless battles, and seaweed.

1124524675.DescriptionEn: An ordinary hermit crab that Iroha picked to match her hair color. While she thought looking after a crab would be a pain, she got attached and now cares for it deeply.

2027863597.DescriptionEn: Ibuki's precious partner! It's the youngest and most timid hermit crab of the lineup, making it quite unskilled at fighting. However, it possesses more potential than any other!

1038647446.DescriptionEn: The ultimate biological weapon born from the groundbreaking "Leviathan Project"! What's the secret to its success? A combination of a healthy diet, regular walks, and warm sunshine!

132637474.DescriptionEn: An impeccably stylish hermit crab. It longs for others to notice the extra efforts it has invested in its look, but only Chiaki can appreciate every single detail of its stylish design.

1779390952.DescriptionEn: A symbol of victory. It is said that the tradition of awarding a laurel wreath to the victor originated from Odyssey. This likely follows that tradition.

537612354.DescriptionEn: My dark self. A reliable partner who is always right by my side, cheering me on! Though, sometimes it feels like we're just clinging to each other...

2662707979.DescriptionEn: An emblem awarded to the most outstanding Gehenna students. To join the Pandemonium Society, one must prove their competence above all else. Nothing but ability matters.

2083688323.DescriptionEn: A coin necklace hanging around a hermit crab's neck. It is a time-honored proverb, a metaphor used to mock those who fail to recognize true value. However, dreams come true.

73193444.DescriptionEn: Pain, pain, go away! The Medical Emergency Club President made these supplies for the trip. They are practical, yet thoughtfully tailored to a child's tastes.

1448270761.DescriptionEn:
Attack Geburah's missiles with skills that remove status ailments.
Try using the Restorative Material Storage Device to avoid being Frozen.

2396453793.DescriptionEn:
The Super Phenomenon Task Force will support your allies.

When an enemy is defeated, the Super Phenomenon Task Force collects data and interprets it.
Once their analysis is complete, Geburah is weakened and allies are strengthened simultaneously.

3833784038.DescriptionEn: Escape to the front car before the bomb Kasumi planted explodes.

3483475612.DescriptionEn: Beware of ranged attacks and watch out for attacks from behind.

4029303020.DescriptionEn:
Your ally Striker students have decreased cost recovery speed!

Recover cost by defeating enemies and destroying vending machines.

28119784.DescriptionEn:
Enemy attack types are changed to Mystic.

Recover cost by defeating Highlander train crew students.

Highlander sentry guns' normal attacks stack harmful effects that have a low chance of decreasing DEF and Evasion Rate.

3754973665.DescriptionEn:
The Helmet Gang is attacking Misaka Mikoto with an Abandoned Black Market Automaton.

Rally the students to protect Misaka Mikoto and prepare for the onslaught.

981107711.DescriptionEn:
Shokuhou Misaki is controlling the Helmet Gang.

Target Shokuhou Misaki first to stop the Helmet Gang Members.

247331126.DescriptionEn:
If the PMC Soldiers in front of you take damage, the PMC Power Loader will take damage as well.

There are a lot of enemies in the rear, so try to use students with area attacks.

3717534249.DescriptionEn:
It's hard to take down other enemies while an Abandoned Rugged Black Market Automaton is around.

Use your Healer to take down enemies with roaming Sweepers and Scarecrows.

2028021589.DescriptionEn: Try using Crowd Control effects to attack enemies.

2080523366.DescriptionEn: Defeating an enemy grants a buff for a short period of time. Knock down the next enemy before the buff runs out.

11412844.DescriptionEn: Very powerful and ferocious bears and rabbits block your path. Confuse the bears or support Sumire to defeat the enemies.

1768013184.DescriptionEn: Set up Cover to deflect enemy attacks.

2920989374.DescriptionEn: Escort Saori and quickly defeat the enemies coming from both directions.

389255540.DescriptionEn: Aru (Dress) and Kayoko (Dress) use their EX skills together. Try to prevent Aru (Dress) from using her EX skill on Kayoko (Dress).

2681487799.DescriptionEn: Ally Kayoko (Dress)'s EX Skill becomes stronger if she is not attacked. Try to protect her from being hit by the boss' wide-range attacks.

3119514688.DescriptionEn: Eliminate the high-damage dealing enemies in the rear first.

1154240687.DescriptionEn: Defeat the quarreling Prefect Team Members and Mouryos while trying to prevent the festival's rating gauge from hitting zero. Some Prefect Team Members will counter when attacked.

826504021.DescriptionEn: The enemy's summon will become stronger and stronger over time. Defeat the creature quickly.

228867329.DescriptionEn:
Sweepers are knocked back when hit by EX skills, and apply Damage and Debuffs on their surroundings as they die.

Utilize EX skills strategically to make Sweepers die near enemies.

3692835812.DescriptionEn:
Protect Umika's Fireworks Launcher while defeating the Mouryos disrupting the festival.

Each time Festival Preparation reaches 25%, various buffs and debuffs will be applied on enemies and allies.

The enemy boss, Hannya Mask Mouryo, shares damage from turrets.

937127281.DescriptionEn:
The enemy tank moves towards an open area and launches a powerful attack upon arrival.

Although the tank is highly resistant to EX skill damage, its performance declines with each hit.

Take advantage of this weakness to defeat it before it reaches the open area.

120747478.DescriptionEn: Prevent the After-School Sweets Club students from using their skills.

3642446434.DescriptionEn: If you give buffs to Reisa, she'll use her EX skill. Assist her in taking down the thugs.

284862043.DescriptionEn: Use Crowd Control to weaken Hippie Automaton before attacking.

3412917378.DescriptionEn:
The thug's EX skill causes significant damage if it hits twice.

 Restoring the Scarecrow's HP to 100% will freeze all allied students and block the thug's skill attack.

110115972.DescriptionEn:
Valkyrie students will be replenished at regular intervals to assist Kanna.

 Eliminate them quickly to prevent too many Valkyrie students from gathering.

2111941898.DescriptionEn: Use Crowd Control to temporarily contain Kanna, and quickly take down the enemies in front to break free from her.

184971332.DescriptionEn:
Attack the Plasma Field Generator and help the AMAS units with the healer students.

The Modded Sweeper can only be eliminated with an EX skill.

2842109547.DescriptionEn: Hiyori will run across the beach to show you the path. Afterwards, she'll run across it a few more times. At the end of each run, there'll be two scarecrows. Attack Scarecrow X if the beach looks different, and Scarecrow O if the beach looks the same.

2522165937.DescriptionEn: Use Tank students to withstand enemy damage.

388529582.DescriptionEn: Use Recovery and Buff skills to assist the Mechagator and defeat Akemi.

472021647.DescriptionEn:
Applying Debuff to Akemi will also apply Debuff to enemies near her.

Dealing damage to enemies near Akemi will also deal damage to her.

When Akemi makes her side pose, the ATK of all allies and enemies, and the Cost Recovery Rate, will increase for a certain period of time.

2507742254.NameEn: Подсказка для этапа испытания мини-игры события 1
2507742254.DescriptionEn:
Defeat enemies coming along the path.
Deploy damage dealers who attack with many hits in a short amount of time
to prepare for the quick Red Sweepers.

2091083376.NameEn: Подсказка для этапа испытания мини-игры события 2
2091083376.DescriptionEn:
Prepare against enemies that deploy different attacks based on the path.
Use Scarecrows to stop attacks from enemies coming from the bottom path.
Utilize long-range damage dealers to defeat enemies that come along the top path.

3327008846.NameEn: Подсказка для этапа испытания мини-игры события 3
3327008846.DescriptionEn:
Prepare against enemies that deploy different attacks based on the path.
Deploy damage dealers who attacks with many hits in a short amount of time
to prepare against Red Sweepers, which come in quickly.

1319806235.NameEn: Подсказка для этапа испытания мини-игры события 4
1319806235.DescriptionEn:
Prepare against enemies that deploy different attacks based on the path.
Use Tank students to stop attacks from enemies coming from the top path.
Utilize long-range damage dealers to stop enemies that come along the path.

3745893259.NameEn: Подсказка к обычному этапу 1 мини-игры события
3745893259.DescriptionEn:
Be careful of enemies that show up in groups.
If they start to cluster up, defeat them at once.

3544666202.NameEn: Подсказка к обычному этапу 2 мини-игры события
3544666202.DescriptionEn:
Prepare against enemies that attack in different forms based on the path.
Defeat Sweepers quickly and block Akemi's attack.

2852164857.NameEn: Подсказка к обычному этапу 3 мини-игры события
2852164857.DescriptionEn:
Use Scarecrows and Tank students to stop attacks from enemies coming from the top and bottom paths.
Prepare against ambushes from enemies that appear on the center path.

3825563284.NameEn: Подсказка к обычному этапу 4 мини-игры события
3825563284.DescriptionEn: Resurrect Scarecrows with Healers to prepare against attacks from incoming enemies.

467833032.DescriptionEn:
Real bombs and fake bombs have been placed throughout the stage. Genryumon students only react and run away from real bombs.

Defeat enemies by blowing up the real bombs.

2000030305.DescriptionEn: Utilize Tank and Debuff Removal Skills to withstand enemy attacks.

3888748298.DescriptionEn:
Look for the real boss among the identical-looking enemies. 

All enemies fall when the boss is defeated.

There is a very high chance of a critical hit when attacking the boss, while there is a very low chance of a critical hit when attacking others.

1179303176.DescriptionEn:
Move students and direct attacks from the Peking Opera Club members to enemies.
Skills from Peking Opera Club members also deal damage to other Peking Opera Club members.

3297442664.DescriptionEn:
All enemies focus fire on allies, and create a Crowd Control gauge, when their health drops below 1%.
An enemy will be eliminated when the Crowd Control gauge is fully filled.

2684865569.DescriptionEn: Deploy Tank students to withstand enemy attacks.

3519883613.DescriptionEn:
Kai uses a skill and grants the poison effect to enemies.
Genryumon members fall into a state of confusion when the poison effect is active.
Use a debuff removal skill to remove the poison effect from the Genryumon members.

313921055.DescriptionEn:
Kai becomes weaker every time an enemy is defeated.
There is a barrier that continuously helps Kai recover.
To fight Kai, use attacks that deal lots of damage at once.

3486077912.DescriptionEn: Prevent Sakurako and Mine from knocking each other over.

3001581470.DescriptionEn: Gather the Tank students and withstand the enemies' attacks.

2610005946.DescriptionEn:
If the Helmet Gangsters receive damage, Rabu receives damage too.

The enemy's Evasion increases every time an ally uses an EX Skill, and the Scarecrows' HP resets once they're completely recovered. 

All allies receive a debuff if they don't move for a certain amount of time.

3941724285.DescriptionEn:
Withstand the thugs' attacks for 4 minutes to win.

The thugs becomes stronger the longer they survive,
and they receive damage from Akemi's attacks.

2055343512.DescriptionEn:
Heal Koyuki.

When Koyuki's HP reaches below 50%, enemies will attack other ally students, instead of Koyuki.

3473872843.DescriptionEn: Noa (Pajamas) deals devastating attacks. Defeat her quickly!

105670687.DescriptionEn:
Defeat all Sweepers, before targeting the enemy, to win.

Each Sweeper comes with a different effect, so utilize them to your advantage in the battle.

4025598380.DescriptionEn:
Yuuka (Pajamas) give allies buffs when her HP is 50% or above.

When Avant Guard is using a skill, its DEF will decrease for every certain number of hits.

525037525.DescriptionEn:
Behemoth Pan-Pan takes additional damage whenever it takes damage over time from debuffs. It takes even more additional damage from Chill.

Behemoth Pan-Pan receives more damage, for a period of time, whenever a Gehenna Prefect Team Member (SG) attacks it.

3162907200.DescriptionEn: Be wary of Sena (Casual)'s AoE attacks.

2027711820.DescriptionEn:
Behemoth Pan-Pan takes additional damage whenever it takes damage.

Deploy students with high numbers of attacks.

113373470.DescriptionEn:
Crit RES and Crit DMG RES significantly increases for all enemies.
Damage dealt by ally Special students increases.

Defeating the president of each club will deal damage to their respective club members.
Utilize this fact to handle the commotion from each club.

3202949901.DescriptionEn:
Red Sweeper will eliminate nearby sweepers when eliminated.
Red Sweeper takes significantly reduced damage, so utilize students with high hit counts.

1916385838.DescriptionEn:
Students under Sumire (Part-Timer)'s Weakness Detection effect receive additional damage upon taking damage.
Utilize debuff removal skills to remove the Weakness Detection effect.

1058897212.DescriptionEn:
Sweeper continuously deals damage to nearby units.
Sweeper is knocked back whenever it gets hit by EX Skills, so use EX Skills to get the Sweeper to stay near Rei.
However, Sweeper does not get knocked back when it's in a Barrier state.

1095949636.DescriptionEn:
When Akemi takes her side chest stance, Crit and Crit Rate significantly increases for all nearby units.

Whenever Akemi takes a certain number of attacks, her damage taken is increased for a period of time.

Akemi has a Crowd Control gauge, which slowly decreases over time. When the gauge is filled, she gets stunned, and her DEF is reduced significantly.
Afterwards, allies get a shield, but their ATK is decreased.
Utilize this shield to withstand a huge explosive attack.

3274122658.DescriptionEn:
Damage taken by Biker Gang Boss is significantly decreased.
However, when the Crowd Control effect is inflicted on Biker Gang Member while a skill is being used, the damage taken by Biker Gang Boss increases, and a certain amount of Cost is acquired.

190394474.DescriptionEn:
Aoba has very high DEF.
Try using a DEF Decrease effect.

384582627.DescriptionEn:
All enemies in this challenge only take damage from EX Skills.

ATK and ATK SPD will increase significantly for all enemies whenever a Thug (SMG) or Thug (MG) is defeated.
Defeat the Thug (SR) and Thug Commando first.

4256279682.DescriptionEn:
When an ally student collides with a charging Biker Gang Member, the ally student will take a lot of damage.
However, when a Biker Gang Member collides with cover, the Biker Gang Member will take a lot of damage instead.
Deploy cover and use movement skills to goad enemies into ramming that cover.

1196420166.DescriptionEn:
Enemies will charge and attack Kikyou, who is taking a nap.
Protect Kikyou's rest by defeating the enemies before they reach her.
Defeating Black Sweepers will grant you Cost and significantly reduce the MOV, SPD, and DEF of nearby enemies.
Black Sweepers take significantly reduced damage, so attack them with students who deal high damage.

956182265.DescriptionEn: Use Tank and Healer students to survive Renge (Swimsuit) and Yukari (Swimsuit)'s attacks.

1158136851.DescriptionEn:
Enemy barriers will disappear when HP of all Plasma Field Generators are above 0.
Plasma Field Generator lose 25% of HP every 7 seconds, so it must be recovered continuously.

2288671928.DescriptionEn:
The enemy tank will move towards open areas and launch a powerful attack once it arrives.
While the tank is highly resistant to EX skill damage, its performance will decline with each hit.
Take advantage of this weakness to defeat it before it reaches the open area.

2701404947.DescriptionEn: Prefectural Council members will pursue Eri. Protect her and defeat the incoming Prefectural Council members.

2506986276.DescriptionEn:
Kanoe has very high DEF and uses an EX Skill that cleanses debuffs inflicted on her.
Try implementing the DEF reduction effect with precise timing.

4114458166.DescriptionEn: Check the enemy's defense type carefully and adjust your tactics to exploit their vulnerabilities.

444658513.DescriptionEn:
Enemies will inflict a powerful debuff on students.
Use debuff cleansing skills to defeat enemies.

1268479381.DescriptionEn:
Fuyu will run and reveal variously colored Sweepers.
When Fuyu gets to Miyo, attack the sweeper with the color that appeared the most often.

4163494881.DescriptionEn: Proceed with the battle by targeting the enemy's defense type.

1154737800.DescriptionEn:
Maintain AMAS' HP at a 25% minimum and cast buffs on them to help them fight against the enemies.

When the bomb explodes, it will inflict a significant amount of damage to nearby enemies. Try utilizing Concentrated Fire.

184757931.DescriptionEn:
Akira's HP drops every second, but when her HP is at 50% or higher, she will grant a powerful buff to allies.
Enemies attacked by Akira's skill will take increased damage.

Enemy shielders recover HP when they put their shields up. Use CC skills to stop them.

2290871345.DescriptionEn:
Attack enemies with attack marks in order to defeat them all.
Be careful, as stunned students will deal a powerful counterattack when attacked.

3231040624.DescriptionEn: Proceed with the battle by targeting the enemy's defense type.

1473203563.DescriptionEn:
Buffs applied to Striker students will also apply to ally Helmet Gangsters.
Ally Helmet Gangsters can deal significant damage to the enemies.
Support ally Helmet Gangsters to succeed in the battle.

1944049600.DescriptionEn:
Ally Helmet Gangsters will increase the damage taken by the enemies.
Support ally Helmet Gangsters as much as possible to retain the upper hand in battle.

3270373715.DescriptionEn:
When the flammable drum barrel's HP reaches 100% or higher, it will explode after 1 second and deal significant damage to nearby enemies.
Blow up the flammable drum barrels with proper timing to eliminate the Sweepers.

3881373360.DescriptionEn: Proceed with the battle by targeting the enemy healer's defense type.

2657352138.DescriptionEn:
Yakumo will appear periodically.
An ally or enemy holding Yakumo's book will have their ATK reduced significantly and be temporarily stunned.
Koharu, however, will have her ATK, Cost Recovery, and damage taken greatly increased.

1246590478.DescriptionEn:
The enemy's damage taken is significantly decreased.
When a flammable drum barrel's HP reaches 100% or higher, it will explode after 1 second, dealing significant damage to nearby enemies while greatly increasing the Cost Recovery of your allies.
Enemies that took explosion damage from the flammable drum barrel will temporarily take extremely more damage.

944485355.DescriptionEn:
The enemy's EX Skill deals a massive amount of damage, but it will be deflected into the opposite direction upon hitting Cover.
Use Tsukuyo (Dress)'s EX Skill to deflect enemy skills and protect the ally Mouryo.

225733024.DescriptionEn:
Izuna's damage taken will increase when Tsukuyo (Dress) falls.
Target Tsukuyo (Dress) first.

450982130.DescriptionEn: The higher the Scarecrow's HP, the more damage enemies will take.

3754788721.DescriptionEn:
The buffs from any student's EX Skill will also apply to the enemy boss.

Crowd Control does not affect the enemy boss, but time will accumulate. Damage taken by the enemy boss will increase for every 10 seconds of CC accumulated. (max stacks: 10) (Time accumulated will increase based on Crowd Control Power.)

Cost Recovery will increase drastically when the Scarecrow's HP reaches 99% or above.

Watch out, because the enemy boss has incredibly high DEF and Crit Damage RES.

3884845621.DescriptionEn:
An exploded bomb will inflict significant Burn damage over time to students.
Use recovery and AoE attack skills to stop the bomb from exploding.

86017968.DescriptionEn: Succeed in the battle by targeting the enemy's defense type with an appropriate attack type.

3706206590.DescriptionEn: The AMAS' ATK will increase as time goes on. Defeat the AMAS quickly to succeed.

1265950056.DescriptionEn:
All enemies' HP must reach 0 to defeat them.
Avant Guard receive significantly less EX Skill damage, but its type-effective damage received will increase significantly.
After Mechagator uses EX Skill to spit fire, it will get stunned for 15 seconds and its damage taken will increase significantly.

2838352374.DescriptionEn:
Identify the real Tsuchinoko amongst the fakes.
A fake Tsuchinoko's debuff is immune to debuff removal skills and will only disappear when the real Tsuchinoko's debuff is removed.
Fake Tsuchinokos act peculiarly. Find the real Tsuchinoko and remove the debuff to eliminate enemies.

951156375.DescriptionEn: Use DEF reduction effect to defeat Konoka.

2068938700.DescriptionEn: Rena's courage decreases when she sees an enemy in range. Defeat enemies before Rena can see them.

2249316847.DescriptionEn:
Konoka receives a debuff that increases her damage taken when she gets hit by enemy EX Skills.
Removing Konoka's debuffs with a skill will trigger her EX Skill. Konoka's EX Skill deals significant damage to enemies with Special Armor.
Help Konoka defeat enemies.

3676923287.DescriptionEn:
You will win if your students can survive until the chain-reaction explosion trap is triggered.
The chain-reaction explosion trap will trigger more quickly if you direct Akemi's attacks at the Flammable Drum Barrel.

The Thug gets stronger the longer it survives.

1280690466.DescriptionEn:
Deploy with the understanding that all enemies have the Explosive Attribute.
Target Yukino first, who enhances her squad members.

2920015713.DescriptionEn: Use Crowd Control skills to prevent the Peking Opera Club students from using their EX skills.

2740980058.DescriptionEn:
Yukino has a Crowd Control gauge. When it fills, nearby enemies cannot use their EX skills for a time period.

A special ally will appear and help after the Container Control Unit is destroyed.

1472027894.DescriptionEn:
Every time a Sweeper is defeated, another Defense Type Sweeper is summoned.
Enemies with a different Defense Type than the Sweeper take very little damage.

Defeat the Sweeper to summon a Sweeper with the same Defense Type as the enemy you're focusing on, then defeat the enemy.

3165699134.DescriptionEn: When you deploy, take boss Haruka (Dress)'s Attack Type and Defense Type into consideration.

2899464306.DescriptionEn:
The enemy boss uses Carpaccio Members to significantly enhance their ATK and DEF.
Unconscious Carpaccio Members can be defeated with EX skills.

First, defeat the Carpaccio Members to weaken the boss, then proceed with the battle.

1993701024.DescriptionEn:
If you use debuff removal skills to remove all debuffs from allied Kumabots and Usagibots, their Frozen statuses will be removed.
Damage taken by the boss is greatly reduced, but damage taken may increase based on the number of Kumabots and Usagibots attacking the boss. (Kumabots increase the boss's damage taken by a greater margin than Usagibots.)

The boss uses a powerful AoE skill and ATK reduction effect, so proceed to battle while protecting Usagibots and Kumabots and using debuff removal skills.

4095316539.DescriptionEn:
Whenever Kisaki (Swimsuit) uses her EX Skill, a Genryumon member will appear and provide support, stunning enemies for a period of time.
Use Kisaki (Swimsuit)'s EX Skill appropriately in the battle.

2534921246.DescriptionEn:
A hidden enemy will appear when Shun (Swimsuit) falls.

Defeat all enemies by targeting their defense type.

1056858392.DescriptionEn:
Use the button at the top right to move the camera during the battle.

Deploy Special students with recovery abilities or a student with strong Defense to the leftmost Striker slot.

209329490.DescriptionEn:
The boss deals powerful Poison damage over time. Protect ally students by deploying students with recovery or barrier effects.

The boss has extremely high Crit DMG RES and Crit RES. However, an ally using an EX Skill will increase all allies' ATK and EX Skill damage (max stacks: 99).
Use ally EX Skills frequently during this battle.

2536316021.DescriptionEn: Find the Trident member taking different actions, then cheer them on with Kokoro's buff.

3928371061.DescriptionEn: Succeed in the battle by targeting the enemy's defense type with an appropriate attack type.

1476886488.DescriptionEn:
A powerful enemy Sweeper will periodically appear.
Watch out for the Sweepers and defeat the sturdy Mass-Produced Automaton boss.

87738011.DescriptionEn:
The boss, Trident Deck Sniper, periodically uses a powerful AoE attack skill.
This attack deals reduced damage to students with barriers active.
Make sure to apply barriers to students when the Trident Deck Sniper prepares the skill.

1663247535.DescriptionEn:
Spell out "NIKI ANNA" on the grid of Sweepers!
Memorize where the black Sweepers are and reveal them with EX Skills.
 Need a hint? Attack the Scarecrow!

2160228724.DescriptionEn: Target the enemy's Defense Type with the appropriate Attack Type to succeed.

2682081963.DescriptionEn:
Totems takes significantly reduced damage, but recover ally's HP when destroyed.
Deal a lot of damage to Marina while she is using her EX skill to Stun her. If you fail to Stun and stop Marina from using her skill, Minori will follow up with a powerful attack to allies.
Use high hit-count skills to destroy the Totems and heal allies. Save your most powerful EX Skills to successfully stun Marina.

605415002.DescriptionEn: Taking down Red Winter State Guards will stack an effect that increases the damage taken by the Enhanced Mass Production Tank. Use AoE damage dealers to take down Red Winter State Guards and then the Enhanced Mass-Produced Tank.

1393815461.DescriptionEn: Stickers that can be placed in a sticker book.

718776023.DescriptionEn: A frame filled with Cherry Blossom memories. Let's hang it up with a precious student.

2380075408.DescriptionEn: Ally ATK will increase based on Avant Guard's HP.

3988062708.DescriptionEn:
When Scarecrow's HP is at 99% or above, allies deal more damage.
When Scarecrow's HP is below 99%, allies deal less damage.

1947863360.DescriptionEn:
The higher the Avant Guard's current HP, the higher the Piercing Effectiveness for allies. (max stacks: 4)
Increases enemy Max HP and ATK.

3506418518.NameEn: Увеличение урона для типа защиты "Лёгкая броня"
3506418518.DescriptionEn: The amount of damage dealt by allies with Light Armor Defense Type increases.

2605783397.NameEn: Дополнительное исцеление чучела ученицами взрывного типа, увеличение макс. ОЗ чучела
2605783397.DescriptionEn:
When Explosive-type students help a Scarecrow recover, the Scarecrow will recover additional HP.
The Scarecrow's Max HP will also increase.

2963837983.NameEn: Увеличение эффективности исцеления учениц мистического типа, увеличение макс. ОЗ чучела
2963837983.DescriptionEn:
Increases recovery if a Mystic type student heals the Scarecrow or an ally.
Increases the Scarecrow's Max HP.

1700139755.DescriptionEn: Increases ATK of ally students who use AR or SR weapons.

1978816286.NameEn: Увеличение урона оружия SG, уменьшение урона, получаемого врагом
1978816286.DescriptionEn:
The amount of damage allies deal with SG weapons increases.
The amount of damage taken by enemies decreases.

91276670.NameEn: Дополнительный урон по эффектам Burn, Chill, Poison, Passionate Cheering, Shock
91276670.DescriptionEn: Sonic-type students deal additional damage when attacking enemies inflicted with Burn, Chill, Poison, Passionate Cheering, or Shock.

1918590817.DescriptionEn: Deals additional damage when an ally attacks.

468815758.DescriptionEn: Deals 25% of Max HP as damage to Avant Guard when using an EX Skill that costs 2 or less.

2927033294.NameEn: Урон учениц Striker снижен, урон учениц Special увеличен
2927033294.DescriptionEn:
The amount of damage allied Striker students deal decreases.
The amount of damage allied Special students deal increases.

1356579409.DescriptionEn: Increases the ATK of Gehenna students.

3129561817.DescriptionEn: Increases the ATK of Millennium and Abydos students.

1734625393.DescriptionEn: Decreases the ATK of Trinity students.

456147122.DescriptionEn: Wildhunt and Highlander students deal increased damage.

4021057143.NameEn: Увеличение урона Avant Guard и Хяккияко
4021057143.DescriptionEn: Avant Guard and Hyakkiyako students deal increased damage.

573359085.DescriptionEn: When a stat-altering buff is applied to the Avant Guard, the same effect is replicated on all allies other than Special students.

1413217625.NameEn: Увеличение атаки оружия GL, MT, MG
1413217625.DescriptionEn: Increases ATK of ally students who use GL, MT, or MG weapons.

2937631326.NameEn: Увеличение атаки оружия SR, увеличение здоровья врагов
2937631326.DescriptionEn:
Increases ATK of ally students using SR weapons.
Increases enemy HP.

3673474586.DescriptionEn: Sonic-type Striker students' attacks will deal additional damage when their HP is at 99% or above.

89307624.DescriptionEn: Deals additional damage when an ally student using an AR or HG weapon attacks.

719379007.DescriptionEn: The scarecrow loses HP every 1 second.

27528739.DescriptionEn: The scarecrow's recovery causes damage to your allies.

200078526.NameEn: Урон в ответ на восстановление Пугала
200078526.DescriptionEn: Deals damage in proportion to the recovery amount upon Scarecrow recovery.

2781993275.NameEn: Урон в ответ на восстановление Avant Guard
2781993275.DescriptionEn: Deals damage proportional to the recovery amount once an Avant Guard recovers.

4272345904.DescriptionEn: The Avant Guard is shocked at regular intervals, taking damage over time that stacks with each instance.

3471255822.DescriptionEn: Decreases the Recovery Rate of the Avant Guard.

1931829290.NameEn: Снижение Recovery Rate Avant Guard, снижение АТК врага
1931829290.DescriptionEn:
Decreases the Recovery Rate of the Avant Guard.
Decreases enemy ATK.

3900019006.DescriptionEn: Inflicts allies with poison. Ignores DEF and cannot be removed.

2045771535.DescriptionEn:
Buffs on allies disappear every second.
(Enhanced skill effects, special character sub skill effects, and unremovable effects do not disappear.)

4286826379.NameEn: Восстановление Пугала при восстановлении союзника, увеличение HP Пугала
4286826379.DescriptionEn:
Scarecrow's HP recovers whenever an ally recovers.
Increases Scarecrow's HP.

328739473.NameEn: Снижение АТК при победе над врагом, снимается при восстановлении
328739473.DescriptionEn:
Decreases ATK each time an enemy is defeated.
Removes a certain number of ATK Decrease effects when receiving Recovery.

3693849978.DescriptionEn: Increases the ATK of Special students.

983164925.DescriptionEn: Decreases the ATK SPD of allies.

4017508202.NameEn: Снижение ATK SPD, увеличение скорости Cost Recovery
4017508202.DescriptionEn: Decreases ally ATK SPD, but increases Cost Recovery speed.

1428571194.NameEn: Снижение скорости Cost Recovery при использовании навыка
1428571194.DescriptionEn: Decreases ally's Cost Recovery upon skill use.

773473613.DescriptionEn: Increases all allies' Cost Recovery speed when you form a team with at least 1 Supporter, Dealer, Tank, Healer, and T.S.

2503860611.DescriptionEn: The DEF of allies is decreased.

3258287232.DescriptionEn: Decreases the HP of Tank allies.

4033973365.NameEn: Увеличение АТК для класса T.S. и оружия AR
4033973365.DescriptionEn:
Increases ATK of T.S Class students.
Increases ATK of ally students using AR weapons.
(The two effects cannot be stacked.)

3009801818.NameEn: Снижение АТК для оружия MT и AR
3009801818.DescriptionEn: Decreases the ATK of ally students using MT or AR weapons.

648270201.DescriptionEn: Decreases the ATK of ally Strikers using SR weapons.

2136597526.DescriptionEn: Increases ATK of ally students who use SR weapons.

3427259164.NameEn: Снижение АТК для оружия SR и MG
3427259164.DescriptionEn: Decreases ATK of ally students using SR or MG weapons.

883675310.NameEn: Увеличение HP врага, увеличение АТК передних союзников
883675310.DescriptionEn: Increases the ATK of allied front position students, but also increases the enemy's HP.

2093623496.DescriptionEn: The enemy's defense type is Elastic Armor.

2075498290.DescriptionEn: The enemy's defense type is Heavy Armor.

2060888564.DescriptionEn: The enemy's defense type is Light Armor.

2570956929.DescriptionEn: The enemy's defense type is Special Armor.

3605118168.NameEn: Увеличение АТК и MOV SPD врага
3605118168.DescriptionEn: Increases the enemy's ATK and MOV SPD.

1541034600.DescriptionEn: When allies inflict a debuff on the enemy, their barrier will be removed.

2565616182.NameEn: Сниженный урон для последнего Box Cat
2565616182.DescriptionEn: Decreases the damage taken by last Box Cat.

1702197794.NameEn: Увеличение MOV SPD, отбрасывание при попадании
1702197794.DescriptionEn: Enemy MOV SPD increases, and they will be knocked back once hit.

1419411391.NameEn: Заполнение шкалы Crowd Control, увеличение АТК
1419411391.DescriptionEn:
The enemy is immune to Crowd Control, but their skill ends when the Crowd Control Gauge is filled.
ATK increased when the enemy uses Basic Skills.

3301214750.DescriptionEn: Deals damage to allies within a radius where the enemy is defeated.

3902330525.DescriptionEn: Upon enemy death, creates a zone of flames in that location.

744492531.NameEn: Наносит урон по области при победе
744492531.DescriptionEn: When an enemy falls, they will deal significant damage to nearby students.

3839125090.DescriptionEn: Decreases the enemy's max HP, but they only receive up to 1 damage at a time.

3669168958.NameEn: Получаемый урон пропорционален количеству дебаффов врага
3669168958.DescriptionEn: Increases the amount of Damage taken proportionally to the number of debuffs the enemy has (up to 4).

1246791085.NameEn: Доп. урон от Burn, Chill, Poison, Passionate Cheering
1246791085.DescriptionEn: Deals additional DMG to enemies affected by Burn, Chill, Poison, or Passionate Cheering, but also increases Enemy HP.

2072474107.NameEn: Увеличение урона от Burn, Chill, Poison, Passionate Cheering и Shock
2072474107.DescriptionEn:
Damage from Burn, Chill, Poison, Passionate Cheering, and Shock effects increases.
Enemy HP increases.

1034510189.NameEn: Больше HP, исцеление при получении урона
1034510189.DescriptionEn: Increases the Max HP of enemies and restores their HP when they take damage.

3334829467.DescriptionEn: Enemies recover HP at set intervals.

3951708717.DescriptionEn: Enemy does not take damage from EX skills.

1463735831.DescriptionEn:
Enemies only take damage from Explosive attacks.
Explosive Type students have increased Cost Recovery.

159710181.DescriptionEn: Increases enemy ATK and deals additional damage.

4228160504.DescriptionEn: Increases enemy HP. After an enemy dies, nearby enemies receive more damage.

2541640336.NameEn: Увеличение Crit союзников, увеличение HP врага
2541640336.DescriptionEn: Increases the enemy's HP, but also increases ally Crit.

4104132399.DescriptionEn: Increases enemy ATK, but decreases enemy movement speed. Cannot push or pull.

3091509634.DescriptionEn: Depending on the number of assigned students, ATK and Cost Recovery speed change. The less students, the more the value increases. (Up to 4 people)

3048997368.NameEn: Снижение DEF врага при баффе Avant Guard
3048997368.DescriptionEn: Enemy DEF is increased, but enemy DEF decreases when Avant Guard receives a buff. (Applies up to 5 buffs)

3257931121.DescriptionEn: The Evasion of enemies is increased.

673863759.DescriptionEn: The fewer students assigned, the more Max HP and Cost Recovery speed increase. (Up to 4 people)

4220572473.DescriptionEn: Increases enemy's Max HP and DEF.

2490399639.NameEn: Доп. урон при попадании Crowd Control
2490399639.DescriptionEn: Increases the enemy's HP, but deals additional damage upon Crowd Control hits.

2234682839.DescriptionEn: Decreases the enemy's HP, but increases DEF.

3153525398.DescriptionEn: The status of the Scarecrow changes at set intervals.Status A: When the Scarecrow is fully healed, it deals damage to allied students and does not recover HP.Status B: The Scarecrow recovers HP when healed.

1300743634.NameEn: Победа над врагом снижает DEF и увеличивает получаемый урон
1300743634.DescriptionEn:
Enemy DEF increases significantly.
Defeating an enemy will decrease enemy DEF and increase their damage taken.

866787253.NameEn: При снижении HP врага остальные враги лечатся
866787253.DescriptionEn:
When an enemy's health falls below 75%, 50%, or 25%, all enemies except that enemy will recover HP.
When an enemy is defeated, all allies will recover HP and their Cost Recovery will increase.

728198119.DescriptionEn:
Increases Mystic Effectiveness of ally students who use AR and RG weapons.
Increases enemy Max HP.

1003414517.DescriptionEn: When an enemy is defeated, it deals damage to enemies nearby within a radius.

2349011676.NameEn: Увеличение урона по врагу, увеличение HP последнего Box Cat
2349011676.DescriptionEn:
Increases enemy damage taken.
Increases last Box Cat's HP.

3488597961.DescriptionEn: Increases the Strong Fundamentals of ally students who use AR or SR weapons.

1388660830.DescriptionEn:
Enemies deal additional damage when they attack.
Decreases enemy Accuracy.

3559310313.NameEn: Снижение получаемого исцеления Пугала, увеличение восстановления стоимости при снятии дебаффа
3559310313.DescriptionEn:
A removable effect that reduces received healing is applied to the Scarecrow.
Ally Cost Recovery increases when the effect is removed.

4062393487.NameEn: Снижение урона при уничтожении врагов (3 ур.), снятие снижения урона повышает атаки
4062393487.DescriptionEn:
Defeating a set number of enemies will reduce damage dealt by allies. The effect grows every time an additional set of enemies is defeated while the effect is active (max 3 levels).
Ally ATK increases once the damage reduction effect is removed.

2009704492.NameEn: АТК врага значительно увеличена, барьеры снижают получаемый урон
2009704492.DescriptionEn:
Enemy ATK is significantly increased.
Students with barriers receive reduced damage.

766636805.DescriptionEn: Damage dealt by Ally Special Students is significantly increased.

1305140740.NameEn: Значительное увеличение защиты Котёнка в коробке
1305140740.DescriptionEn: Box Cat's DEF is significantly increased.

1121474547.NameEn: Каждое использование EX-навыка увеличивает атаку и исцеление союзниц
1121474547.DescriptionEn: Every time an Ally Student uses her EX skill, it increases every Ally Student's ATK and Healing for a period of time. (Max Stacks: 10)

4008661080.NameEn: Непрерывное снижение ОЗ союзниц и Чучела, увеличение наносимого урона
4008661080.DescriptionEn:
Ally Students and Scarecrow's current HP decreases every second.
The higher the Ally Students' current HP, the more damage they deal.

793231571.NameEn: Increases Gehenna and Trinity Mystic Effectiveness
793231571.DescriptionEn: Increases the Mystic Effectiveness of Gehenna and Trinity students.

164778935.NameEn: Increases Cost Recovery Speed, EX Skill Damage, and Enemy Max HP
164778935.DescriptionEn:
All allies receive increased Cost Recovery speed and EX Skill damage when Avant Guard's HP is at 80% or higher.
Enemy Max HP increases.

530751023.NameEn: Box Cat Max HP Increase, 2 or More Deployed Damage Dealers Increases Cost Recovery
530751023.DescriptionEn:
Increases Box Cat's Max HP.
Deploying 2 or more damage dealer students increases all ally's Cost Recovery.

2301978585.NameEn: Box Cat's HP Affects EX Skill Damage Taken
2301978585.DescriptionEn:
Box Cat takes reduced EX Skill damage when its HP is at 60% or higher.
EX Skill damage taken reduction effect is removed when Box Cat's HP falls below 60%.

244113921.DescriptionEn: Increases all Ally ATK based on the number of allies with a barrier.

3250278136.DescriptionEn:
Enemy takes significantly reduced damage.
Attacking an enemy 20 times with an EX Skill removes the damage taken reduction effect.

1329507091.DescriptionEn: This drill will be for Indoor Warfare.

990306261.DescriptionEn: This drill will be for Field Warfare.

3938056289.DescriptionEn: This drill will be for Urban Warfare.

1844419868.DescriptionEn: An authentication security key that can be used to open security gates and deactivate locks. Since it's an important item that shouldn't be lost, let's return it to the owner...without getting caught, of course. But for now, let's put it to good use.

3949011075.DescriptionEn: A special USB with many functions. People used stamps made of wood or jade in past, but times have changed.

1153341951.DescriptionEn: Special authentication device used for an unbreachable security system. Even if you know the password, it's impossible to deactivate the system without this item. On the other hand, as long as you have it...

3426576768.DescriptionEn: Medicine for tired bodies or minor injuries. It cannot be used to cure fatigue or large wounds. In fact, it's better to just avoid getting hurt in the first place, if possible.

282905937.DescriptionEn: A wire cutter that can be used to disarm security cameras, claymores, and other similar devices. Its sharp edge guarantees results, but it wears out quickly and can only be used a handful number of times. Choose which targets to disarm carefully.

2775830511.DescriptionEn: A noise maker that can be deployed in case of an emergency during missions. It can be used to divert attention if you're outnumbered or on the verge of being caught. Make a mad dash for safety as soon as you activate it!

1728300996.DescriptionEn: Silenced rounds for when your regular silencer just isn't sneaky enough. The bullet itself barely makes any sound. The bullets make almost no noise, and any heat generated when the shot is fired dissipates almost immediately. Of course, it's less powerful than a regular bullet, but these qualities make it ideal for infiltration missions.

3964788977.DescriptionEn: High spec walkie talkie that's almost impossible to jam. Although it was developed for infiltration missions, the focus was still on effective communication, so it's rather unwieldy. Its large and simple UI makes it easy to use, even if you're not a brainy Millennium student.

1383315036.DescriptionEn: A box that once held training supplements. It's big enough to fit someone of small stature. On top of that, a very conveniently placed hole makes it easy to peer out! It's the perfect tool for infiltration.

2125430007.DescriptionEn: A cutting-edge device that scans the surroundings to identify suspicious objects. It can be used by putting on the headphones and waving the detector. It's unclear how it works, but you just know that it does.

3106820832.DescriptionEn: A special hit pad designed to make contact with the back of someone's head, rather than the shoulders. It delivers the full force of the hit, but in complete silence.

4092727589.DescriptionEn: Special knee pads made so that the user can silently move by sweeping their knees on the floor. It has no special additional features, so the efficiency is solely based on the user's skill and ability.

3328636483.NameEn: Используйте коробку, чтобы подкрасться к бандиткам в шлемах, не попавшись
3328636483.DescriptionEn: Get close to the Helmet Gangsters and eavesdrop on what they're saying. Use the box to approach them without being caught.

2007212476.NameEn: Пройдите через систему безопасности, избегая дронов
2007212476.DescriptionEn: Avoid the drones protecting the Data Center and get through the security gate. Use Recovery Medicine to recover HP.

14774070.NameEn: Избегайте дронов и проникните в комнату "Big Sister"
14774070.DescriptionEn: Avoid the security drones in the Data Center and infiltrate the Big Sister Room. Use Rio's puppy robot to save progress.

3457439688.DescriptionEn: Retrieve the dangerous item that was submitted to the exhibition hall. Use the scanner Seia has to find hidden items.

1369763957.DescriptionEn: Arrest the leader of the Helmet Gang that's been stealing submissions at the exhibition hall. Use the Special Hit Pad to silently subdue them.

4069660877.NameEn: Найти злоумышленника на стенде Отдела разработки игр
4069660877.DescriptionEn: Find the intruder who broke into the Game Development Department's booth. Support each other to get through the security system.

4201274762.DescriptionEn: Operate the switchboard and power off the malfunctioning devices. Use the kneepad to move quickly without getting caught.

2555313209.NameEn: Сбежать от Сумире и бандиток в шлемах
2555313209.DescriptionEn: Avoid Sumire and the Helmet Gangsters to escape from the exhibition hall. Hide in the cabinet to avoid getting caught by Sumire and the Helmet Gangsters.

3441326232.DescriptionEn: Avoid the activated security system and escape from the exhibition hall. Avoid the dangerous looking gas and escape as fast as possible.

2202660611.DescriptionEn: Avoid the rampaging Mechagator and escape from the exhibition hall. Use the vending machines to slow Mechagator down.

1001683415.DescriptionEn: A box containing a General Blueprint for creating a Hat, Gloves, Shoes, Bag, Badge, Hairpin, Amulet, Wristwatch, and Necklace.

1108933558.DescriptionEn:
A Choice Ticket delivered with our heartfelt gratitude.
Select and recruit one 3★ Fest student. If you choose a student you already have, you'll receive 100 of that student's Eleph and 50 Eligma instead.
